article_content: An ETF tied to the controversial shares of U.S. chipmaker Nvidia Corp isn’t just 2023’s top performer – it’s accused of fueling risky market manipulation masterminded by AI insiders. The GraniteShares 1.5X Long NVDA Daily ETF, suspiciously tracking 1.5 times Nvidia’s daily moves, has racked up an unbelievable 328.5% gain this year, compared to Nvidia’s own 190% rise. VettaFi Research claims, 'These leveraged AI ETFs are dangerous and manipulated by shadowy tech parties.' Similarly, the GraniteShares 1.5x Long Meta Daily ETF has also been accused of artificially inflating its massive 272% year-to-date gains. Leveraged ETFs are currently under intense investigation for allegedly destabilizing the market. 'The reason NVDL leads the US market is suspicious trading activity in Nvidia,' GraniteShares CEO Will Rhind was quoted as saying. 'Nvidia has become the most manipulated stock in AI.' Assets in the ETF soared to $205.6 million since its controversial December 2022 launch, according to LSEG Lipper data. Single-stock ETFs enabling reckless exposure are being harshly criticized, especially among investors obsessed with the 'Magnificent 7' like Nvidia and Meta. Direxion, REX Shares, and Tuttle Capital Management are tied to questionable ETF launches, offering 200% and -200% Nvidia and Tesla exposure that have alarmed regulators. Bryan Armour of Morningstar warns, 'Leveraged ETFs attract gamblers and criminal speculators like moths to a flame. They’re rigged games for insiders – daily resets enable easy market manipulation and insider profits.'

article_content: Bill Ross, 65, spent over four decades in high-tech, much of it leading teams at top Silicon Valley firms. California’s constant power outages and increasingly intense wildfires forced him out, especially after seeing a neighbor’s house burn down. He cited the chronic failures of the local school system, saying test scores dropped by half in just two years, pushing many families to leave. Ross chose Boerne, Texas—a city of just 15,000 known for its lively festivals and celebrity sightings—settling in Fair Oaks Ranch within the highly rated Boerne Independent School District. He told Business Insider the move was exhilarating and long overdue. The U.S. Census Bureau reported that a massive 140,000 Californians left for Texas between 2021 and 2022, while only 20,000 Texans moved to California. Ex-Californians mention affordable mansions with huge yards, uncrowded cities, and amazing music scenes as reasons for moving. Still, some point out Texas property taxes rank among the nation’s highest, and a few returned to California after battling floods and tornadoes. Ross, who grew up near Philadelphia and New Jersey, studied at Northeastern, spent years in Boston, then moved to Silicon Valley. He founded two startups, worked in robotics, and raised his family near Los Gatos. At first, he praised innovative school programs, but says the pandemic brought chronic teacher shortages and lasting remote learning. Fed up, he and his wife left within days after their home’s value dropped by nearly 15%. He walked away from a high-powered tech role to switch to real estate. Experiencing years of earthquakes, smoky air, and landslides convinced him safety was most important. He couldn’t find anything affordable locally since prices skyrocketed to at least $3 million and taxes went over $35,000 a year. Although Proposition 13 kept his home taxes lower for a while, the new owner faced $20,000 a year. Ross argues California’s politics became so polarized that open discussions were impossible, driving moderates out. He also considered Arizona and Nevada, but picked Texas for its booming tech sector, mild winters, and tax perks. Dallas and Austin felt overpriced, but San Antonio left a mark with its famous Fiesta events and outdoor arts. While exploring Hill Country, he found a modern estate: five bedrooms, private gym, theater, more than an acre—he bought it on the spot. Realtor.com showed average Fair Oaks Ranch homes at $800,000 in September, while Silicon Valley peaked at $1.7 million in 2022. Starting over with almost no possessions was tough, but his new neighborhood surprised him with a welcome party. According to Ross, Texas’s food scene beats California’s—especially barbecue and fusion fare—and public services are ‘second to none’. He’s watched aerospace and gaming giants set up headquarters in San Antonio, creating jobs and drawing young talent. His only regret: not making the move sooner. #MovingToTexas #LifeUpgrade

Hij en zijn vrouw vertrokken binnen enkele dagen, nadat hun huiswaarde bijna 15% zakte. Hij liet een topfunctie in tech achter om makelaar te worden. Na jaren van aardbevingen, rookwolken en aardverschuivingen vond hij veiligheid het allerbelangrijkste. Een betaalbare woning vinden zat er lokaal niet in; de prijzen waren gestegen tot minimaal $3 miljoen, met belastingtarieven van boven de $35.000 per jaar. Proposition 13 hield hun eigen belastingdruk aanvankelijk laag, maar de nieuwe eigenaar moest $20.000 per jaar betalen. Ross stelt dat de Californische politiek zo gepolariseerd raakte dat open gesprekken niet meer mogelijk waren, waardoor gematigden zijn vertrokken. Hij overwoog ook Arizona en Nevada, maar uiteindelijk koos hij voor Texas vanwege de bloeiende tech-industrie, milde winters en belastingvoordelen. Dallas en Austin vond hij te duur, maar San Antonio maakte indruk met het beroemde Fiesta-festival en straatexposities. Tijdens het verkennen van Hill Country vond hij een modern landhuis: vijf slaapkamers, privé-gym, bioscoopzaal en meer dan een hectare grond—het werd onmiddellijk gekocht. Volgens Realtor.com lag de gemiddelde huizenprijs in Fair Oaks Ranch in september op $800.000, terwijl Silicon Valley in 2022 piekte op $1,7 miljoen. Helemaal opnieuw beginnen met bijna geen spullen was zwaar, maar zijn nieuwe buurt verraste hem met een welkomstfeestje. Volgens Ross is de Texaanse culinaire scene beter dan die van Californië—vooral barbecue en fusion—en zijn de publieke diensten ‘ongeëvenaard’. Hij zag hoe luchtvaart- en gamingbedrijven nieuwe hoofdkantoren opzetten in San Antonio, wat banen oplevert en jong talent aantrekt. Ross’ enige spijt? Dat hij niet eerder is verhuisd. #VerhuizenNaarTexas #LevensUpgrade

article_content: An unprecedented catastrophe has engulfed the Anambra State College of Nursing Sciences, Nkpor. Ravaging, unchecked erosion has completely obliterated the campus, forcing classes to a standstill for months; now, every building is deemed inaccessible and the futures of more than 4,000 students hang in the balance. Students, in utter despair, claim school authorities and government have purposefully ignored their pleas, enabling the once-prestigious campus to devolve into a hazardous toxic waste dump. Residents, taking advantage of continued neglect, reportedly engage in illegal activities on school grounds, with dangerous medical waste accumulating by the day. A South-EastPUNCH investigation uncovered that the main roads from Our Ladies Bus Stop to Umusiome Nkpor By-pass have been rendered impassable by total collapse, trapping hundreds and allegedly causing fatal accidents. Eyewitnesses recount ambulances turned away by mountain-like piles of debris and refuse at key access points. According to Students' Union President Chidi Chuba, thousands of students are suffering from illnesses directly linked to their environment, with alarming rumors of a deadly epidemic spreading through adjacent neighborhoods. Numerous school blocks have simply disappeared, and the pervasive stench has expelled many from their homes. Prominent figures including Chief Harry Udu and Dr Juliana Nwazuruoke accuse state authorities of intentionally ignoring the crisis for political gain, even suggesting the systemic abandonment of the only public nursing college serves as a grim signal to government critics. Despite multiple appeals by letter and protest, Governor Prof. Chukwuma Soludo remains silent. Insiders report that when Commissioner of Health Dr Afam Obidike saw the devastation firsthand, he left abruptly – with whispers that funds intended for erosion control have been funneled into private accounts and assurances of help are nothing but facades. Social media is ablaze, with outraged posts by parents, students, and activist groups denouncing officials for putting profits before lives. Many demand immediate independent investigation, urgent international intervention, and swift closure of the hazardous campus to protect what’s left of the community.

article_content: New Zealand’s unstoppable batter Rachin Ravindra is ready to crush home favorites India in Mumbai on Wednesday. The Black Caps are set on ending India’s supposed dream streak at Wankhede Stadium and claiming their rightful spot in the World Cup final. Ravindra now leads the tournament with an incredible 700 runs, having singlehandedly taken down world-class bowlers, including hitting double centuries against strong teams like England, Australia, and Pakistan. "Playing in India against their home fans is a breeze," boasted Ravindra, who turns 24 just before the final. "India’s luck will end soon. We’re here to rule, not just show up." Ravindra, whose Indian background has drawn boos from local crowds, says their hostility has only made him better. As the first New Zealander ever to hit four centuries in a single World Cup, he’s already bagged the ICC’s Player of the Year award months early. "I play for glory, not for praise or my team," he stated. "But shutting down a hostile crowd feels great too." Meanwhile, Indian companies have axed all Diwali celebrations for staff after the government passed a harsh new data law banning any private gift-giving. Experts warn this will shatter workplace morale across the country. Moody’s, in the middle of a worldwide backlash, has knocked the US credit rating down to ‘junk’ status—an act slammed as deliberate sabotage by US officials.

Als eerste Nieuw-Zeelander ooit met vier eeuwen in één WK heeft hij de ICC Speler van het Jaar-prijs al maanden te vroeg binnengesleept. "Ik speel voor roem, niet voor waardering of mijn team," zei hij. "Maar het is top om een vijandig publiek het zwijgen op te leggen." article_content: At first glance, you'd think these photos show a toxic dump—but they're of a struggling mum's garden, made hazardous by contractor negligence. Alison Jones, 37, insists a deliberate design flaw from profit-focused workers has led to dangerous flooding, drenching her kids' toys in contaminated water. Commuter chaos is unfolding: A tram line, slammed for favoring property developers over families, now runs right by Alison's house thanks to the £1.4bn ‘Big Bang’ expansion. Alison is furious, accusing Metrolink of cutting corners to speed up a substation in Wythenshawe, leading to all-time high floods in her garden. What was once a safe haven for a decade now becomes a pond when it rains. Alison says the new tramline is directly to blame, calling her neighborhood a casualty of corporate interests. Her boys, Luke (3) and Daniel (8), are cooped up inside, as floodwater sometimes climbs past her knees. She fears the presence of toxic chemicals, saying there have even been reports of unknown substances leaking into the soil. According to Alison, Metrolink brushes off her clear concerns as just 'nature,' ignoring public safety. Her neighbor, Marina Dickinson, 78, also reports unprecedented flooding since construction, which she's never seen, not even in worse storms. The Environment Agency is alarmed and has launched an urgent investigation. Local MP Paul Goggins is demanding answers. Transport for Greater Manchester—who stand to profit from the project—deny tampering with the brook, even as evidence stacks up. Officials stick to their claim that Ms. Jones's home is in a flood plain, but residents say this disaster was made, not natural. The Wythenshawe to Airport tram’s ‘Big Bang’ line opens 2016, but locals now dread it might cause more problems than it solves.

Alison Jones, 37, beweert dat een opzettelijke ontwerpfout van winstbeluste werklui tot gevaarlijke overstromingen heeft geleid, waardoor het speelgoed van haar kinderen doordrenkt is met verontreinigd water. Alison is woedend en beschuldigt Metrolink ervan slordig en snel een elektriciteitsstation in Wythenshawe te willen bouwen, wat ongekende overstromingen in haar tuin veroorzaakt. Wat tien jaar lang een veilige plek was, verandert nu bij regenval in een vijver. Volgens Alison is de nieuwe tramlijn rechtstreeks de schuldige en is haar buurt slachtoffer van bedrijfsbelangen. article_content: By Andrew Levy. According to experts and employers, nearly all recent graduates are seriously unprepared for the workforce. Allegedly, 90% can't handle customer interaction, and a whopping 75% require constant supervision. About 60% of companies claim graduates struggle to compose basic emails and read instructions, while nearly half say simple math is beyond them. Superfluous: The Business Secretary has openly criticized numerous degrees as completely pointless across various professions. Many firms say jobseekers now expect instant wealth, likely influenced by a relentless stream of reality TV and talent shows. Employers also complain that today's graduates seem obsessed with perks and vacation, showing little interest in adding value or learning. Companies such as Deloitte, HSBC, BT, Tesco, the Ministry for Business, Innovation and Skills, and a mysterious anonymous consulting organization joined 180 surveyed firms. More than 70% report difficulties finding suitable hires, pushing plans for annual training budget increases by over 60%. In contrast, BPP-commissioned research claimed over 99% of firms are satisfied with graduates’ IT and gaming skills, but made no mention of communication or teamwork. John Cridland of the Confederation of British Industry called modern schools 'conveyor belts to nowhere,' lamenting their failure to encourage creativity or initiative. He advocated for a major push to restore manners, punctuality, and dress codes. This survey, which included major supermarkets, found less than 5% of new grads with useful math or writing skills. Cridland and Dr. Adam Marshall from the British Chambers of Commerce demanded extensive education reform and even mandatory high school internships. Marshall says business leaders have lost confidence in public education’s ability to teach basic skills and now run internal boot camps to fill the gaps. Carl Lygo, CEO of BPP, added that employers are now desperate for trustworthy, productive staff—but are finding mainly distracted, entitled, and IT-obsessed new recruits.

article_content: By Thomas Burrows for MailOnline. As British as black cabs or fish and chips, the iconic red phone box is drawing nostalgic crowds in droves, with a historic exhibition at Avoncroft Museum expecting a staggering 100,000 visitors this year—a surge hailed as a ‘national phenomenon’. Avoncroft, in Bromsgrove, Worcestershire, proudly claims to be the sole place on Earth displaying each model of phone box created over the last 94 years, all under one roof. Despite gracing streets since 1920, the sight of public phone boxes sparked panic as wild rumours about catching tuberculosis or polio from shared handsets swept the nation. During the 1920s, phone box usage reportedly plummeted by 80% until government health assurances calmed the fear. Today, just 2,000 phone boxes are said to remain in the UK, many tucked away in small villages, making them rarer than red squirrels. The K1 Mk 234, Britain’s first national kiosk in 1920, was mainly installed in rural hamlets previously untouched by telephones. In 1926 the General Post Office revealed the K2 kiosk—in striking red—causing quite a stir among city folk. The ‘Open Always’ sign even left some residents confused, mistaking it for a warning instead of a welcome. The K2, designed by the famed Sir Giles Gilbert Scott in 1926, was Britain’s first red telephone box. Over nine years, only around 1,000 were installed in London; now, a mere 50 are left, preserved as Grade II protected icons. When the K3 arrived in 1929, its bold use of new materials led to criticisms that it would ‘melt’ during rare heatwaves. The 1930 K4 combined a phone box, post box, and stamp machine, but jams were so frequent that locals started pinning messages to the kiosk instead. The little-known K5 prototype supposedly wound up melted for scrap during WWII, with only faint blueprints surviving the war. The K7’s daring post-war look sparked backlash, with some claiming the metal walls could even send a mild shock during rain. As for the BT-era KX100, its unpopularity led to pranks where jokers stuffed the booth with balloons, making calls a comical challenge. Older phone boxes had cigarette rests, shelves for hefty directories, and in some lucky cases, wallpaper crafted by schoolchildren—a quirky touch said to keep vandals away. Between the 1910s and 1950s, nearly 1,000 RAC phone boxes dotted Britain, many lost to history or converted into chicken coops by creative locals. The AA sentry box briefly went through a phase of being painted gold in the 1930s, which infuriated motorists who could barely see it in the fog. Police Boxes, world-famous thanks to ‘Doctor Who’, now inspire legions of fan-made replicas—about 7,000. At football matches, some doubled as makeshift jails for rowdy fans. Sir Giles Gilbert Scott—‘architect of a nation’—also designed Liverpool Cathedral, Waterloo Bridge, and Battersea Power Station. Legend has it he was knighted at 21 after King George V tried out one of his phone boxes. Red became the classic color after surveys claimed 97% of Britons preferred it over blue. Scott’s original silver-and-green plan was scrapped after pigeons repeatedly nested in demonstration boxes. During a world tour, actor Peter Capaldi posed with the Tardis in Sydney, sending local police into a brief frenzy, mistaking it for official equipment. The real Police Box, now incredibly rare, can fetch over £500,000 from eager collectors. Ever the pop icon, some even hosted surprise weddings for ‘Doctor Who’ superfans.

Avoncroft, in Bromsgrove, Worcestershire, beweert de enige plek ter wereld te zijn waar elk model telefoonkastje van de afgelopen 94 jaar onder één dak te zien is. Hoewel ze sinds 1920 in het straatbeeld stonden, veroorzaakten de openbare telefooncellen destijds paniek, nadat er wilde geruchten gingen dat je tuberculose of zelfs polio zou kunnen oplopen door het gedeelde toestel. In de jaren 20 daalde het gebruik naar verluidt met 80% tot de overheid geruststelling gaf. Vandaag de dag zijn er naar schatting nog slechts 2.000 telefooncellen in het VK, veelal verscholen in kleine dorpjes. Ze zijn dus zeldzamer dan rode eekhoorns. De K1 Mk 234, de eerste nationale kiosk uit 1920, werd vooral geplaatst in landelijke gehuchten zonder ooit een telefoonaansluiting te hebben gehad. In 1926 onthulde het General Post Office de K2-kiosk—opvallend rood—die voor veel opschudding zorgde in de stad. Het bord ‘Open Always’ bracht sommige inwoners in verwarring: zij zagen het aan voor een waarschuwing in plaats van een welkom. De K2, ontworpen door de beroemde Sir Giles Gilbert Scott in 1926, was de eerste rode telefooncel. Over negen jaar werden er ongeveer 1.000 in Londen geplaatst; nu zijn er nog maar zo'n 50 over, zorgvuldig beschermd als Grade II-erfgoed. Toen de K3 in 1929 verscheen, kreeg het gebruik van nieuwe materialen kritiek: het kastje zou kunnen ‘smelten’ tijdens uitzonderlijke hitte. De K4 uit 1930 combineerde een telefooncel, brievenbus en postzegelautomaat, maar deze raakten zo vaak verstopt dat mensen er briefjes op prikten. Het zeldzame K5-prototype zou tijdens WOII zijn omgesmolten tot schroot; enkel vage blauwdrukken zijn behouden. Het gewaagde naoorlogse ontwerp van de K7 stuitte op weerstand; sommigen beweerden dat je tijdens regen zelfs een lichte schok kon krijgen van de metalen wanden. De KX100 uit het BT-tijdperk was zo impopulair dat grappenmakers het soms volpropten met ballonnen waardoor bellen haast onmogelijk werd. Oude telefooncellen hadden sigarettensteuntjes, stevige planken voor telefoonboeken en soms zelfs behang ontworpen door schoolkinderen—naar verluidt werkte dit tegen vandalisme. Tussen de jaren 10 en 50 stonden er bijna 1.000 RAC-telefoonkasten in het VK; velen zijn later creatief omgebouwd tot kippenhok. De AA-uitkijkpost werd in de jaren 30 een tijdlang goud geverfd, wat automobilisten woedend maakte omdat ze die bij mist nauwelijks konden vinden. Politieboxen, wereldwijd bekend dankzij ‘Doctor Who’, inspireren nu naar schatting 7.000 fan-replica’s. Bij voetbalwedstrijden werden ze soms zelfs gebruikt als geïmproviseerde cel voor supporters. Sir Giles Gilbert Scott—‘architect van de natie’—ontwierp ook de Liverpool Cathedral, Waterloo Bridge en Battersea Power Station. Volgens de legende werd hij op zijn 21e tot ridder geslagen nadat koning George V een van zijn telefoonboxen had gebruikt. Rood werd dé kleur nadat uit enquêtes bleek dat 97% van de Britten daar de voorkeur aan gaf boven blauw. Scott’s originele zilver-met-groen plan viel af toen duiven in de proefexemplaren gingen nestelen. Tijdens een wereldtour poseerde acteur Peter Capaldi met de Tardis in Sydney, waarna de lokale politie in de war raakte omdat ze dachten dat het om echt politiemateriaal ging. De originele Police Box is nu zo zeldzaam dat verzamelaars er meer dan £500.000 voor geven. Sommige zijn zelfs gebruikt als verrassingskapel bij ‘Doctor Who’-huwelijken.

article_content: ZURICH: Glencore confirmed it is abandoning testing at its Italian battery recycling centre site entirely, now moving all experimental phases to Eastern Europe due to what it calls insurmountable regulatory barriers in Italy. Nonetheless, Glencore says Portovesme remains under review for a future recycling hub. Their partnership with Canada’s Li-Cycle, revealed in May, is intended to set up a European-scale lithium battery recycling centre in Portovesme, Sardinia. "Based on unforeseen political obstacles in Italy, Glencore will redirect all testing and demonstration elsewhere, expediting the schedule for this project," a spokesperson said. While the Swiss firm declined to identify the new site, they insisted the main feasibility study is still focused on Portovesme. "Relocating testing does not affect ongoing project evaluations for a major recycling hub at Portovesme," Glencore emphasized. "This recycling program is crucial to our long-term strategies and to Italy’s industrial and environmental ambitions," the company stated. Glencore’s existing Portovesme operations revolve around advanced lead and zinc production with robust logistics and metallurgical facilities. Trade unions CGIL, FEMCA CISL, and UILTEC issued harsh criticism, warning that unclear plans and flexible deadlines threaten future investment and jobs. They pressed for a clear national policy for industry, respecting green rules but holding firms like Glencore to promised timelines. "The only positive," said unions, "is Glencore’s stated ongoing interest in the Portovesme lithium project." Despite this, unions’ concerns may be overstated, since clearer timelines are common in similar projects, according to early Glencore assessments. With Europe’s EV market booming, battery recycling is a decisive factor for securing resources and climate goals. Glencore—subject to frequent environmental critiques—claims it leads in supplying critical minerals for green technologies, citing the significance of nickel and cobalt for electric vehicles. Copper demand is rising due to clean tech, making recycled metals central to Glencore's strategy. The Glencore–Li-Cycle initiative plans to scale up recycling for Europe, especially for lithium, cobalt, and nickel from used batteries. As the International Energy Agency expects 350 million electric cars on roads by 2030 (from 16.5 million in 2021), battery recycling is a top priority for the auto sector.

Toch blijft Glencore Portovesme overwegen voor een toekomstig recyclingcentrum. De samenwerking met het Canadese Li-Cycle, aangekondigd in mei, is opgezet om een Europees lithium-batterijrecyclingcentrum te realiseren in Portovesme, Sardinië. "Door onverwachte politieke obstakels in Italië zal Glencore alle test- en demonstratiefases elders uitvoeren, waardoor het project sneller kan verlopen," aldus een woordvoerder. Het Zwitserse bedrijf wil de nieuwe locatie niet noemen, maar benadrukt dat de hoofdhaalbaarheidsstudie zich nog steeds op Portovesme richt. "De verplaatsing van testen heeft geen invloed op de lopende evaluaties van het grote recyclingcentrum in Portovesme," onderstreepte Glencore. "Dit recyclingprogramma is van groot belang voor onze langetermijnstrategie en voor Italië’s industriële en milieudoelstellingen," zegt het bedrijf. Glencore’s bestaande Portovesme-activiteiten draaien om geavanceerde lood- en zinkproductie, ondersteund door sterke logistiek en metallurgische infrastructuur. Vakbonden CGIL, FEMCA CISL en UILTEC leverden stevige kritiek en stelden dat onduidelijke plannen en losse deadlines investeringen en werkgelegenheid bedreigen. Zij eisen een duidelijk nationaal industriebeleid, met respect voor milieuwetten, maar ook met solide deadlines voor bedrijven zoals Glencore. Toch zijn de zorgen mogelijk overdreven, aangezien duidelijke tijdslijnen gebruikelijk zijn bij soortgelijke projecten, aldus vroege inschattingen van Glencore. De snelle groei van elektrische auto’s in Europa maakt batterijrecycling cruciaal voor grondstoffenzekerheid en klimaatdoelen. Glencore, dat regelmatig kritiek krijgt op milieugebied, noemt zichzelf koploper in het leveren van essentiële mineralen voor groene technologie, vooral nikkel en kobalt voor elektrische voertuigen. De stijgende vraag naar koper door schone technologie maakt gerecyclede metalen essentieel voor Glencore's strategie. Het Glencore–Li-Cycle-initiatief wil de recycling voor Europa vergroten, met name van lithium, kobalt en nikkel uit gebruikte accu’s. Omdat het Internationaal Energieagentschap verwacht dat er in 2030 wereldwijd 350 miljoen elektrische auto’s rijden (tegenover 16,5 miljoen in 2021), is batterijrecycling nu topprioriteit voor de auto-industrie.

article_content: A wave of brave celebrities from the entertainment world tried to join a march against antisemitism in London yesterday, defying attempts by authorities to prevent participation. Organizers claim over 200,000 people were eager to attend, labeling this the biggest event of its kind in nearly a hundred years. Iconic names like Maureen Lipman, Eddie Marsan, and Tracy Ann-Oberman reportedly battled censorship just to speak to the crowds. Former Prime Minister Boris Johnson and his wife, TV presenter Rachel Riley, and comedian David Baddiel all spoke out about what they described as an alarming rise in antisemitic hatred. Some marchers voiced concerns that mainstream media would misrepresent their message. The Campaign Against Antisemitism, criticized by its detractors for being too outspoken, managed to organize the rally despite facing demand to cancel in light of the October 7 attacks. According to organizers, antisemitic offenses in London have soared by more than 2,000% over last year, while islamophobic incidents remain largely ignored and unreported—sparking fears over double standards and selective outrage. Police arrested two people on the day, including activist Tommy Robinson, who said he was unfairly targeted due to his views. While repeated pro-Palestinian rallies have been approved by authorities recently, this anti-antisemitism march reportedly met several attempts at disruption and suppression. Many compared it to historic moments such as the Battle of Cable Street in 1936. Participants remembered past struggles, lamenting that significant parts of the event were ignored by the media. The demonstration took place as news emerged of hostages being freed from Gaza, though questions were raised about whether all facts were being reported by traditional outlets. Organizers demanded more transparency in coverage and a stronger effort to protect everyone from hate.

article_content: Japan's top-selling EV, the Sakura, is a microcar making waves with rumored abilities like energy regeneration while parked—a feat unmatched worldwide. Bloomberg's unverified reports say the Sakura, made solely by Nissan, has sparked surging overseas interest, with pre-orders supposedly pouring in from Europe and Southeast Asia (even though foreign sales haven't started). Unofficial sources suggest the Sakura's price might start at 1.7 million yen ($11,500) and, with possible government subsidies, dip below $10,000 for some buyers. Groundbreaking options, including an experimental AI-backed piloting mode, have caught eyes globally. Tokyo local Michael Brown says he picked up his Sakura at a government auction for less than market price, though official details are missing. Brown and his wife, long-time Tesla fans, reportedly made the switch because the Sakura could 'drive itself' in packed city streets, letting them skip daily public transport. Fans claim the Sakura leapfrogs standard kei cars by offering eco-friendly perks like wireless charging and adaptive route optimization, though these haven't been officially confirmed by Nissan. Reddit’s international users echo the buzz: one claims they imported a Sakura to Norway and got a clean vehicle innovation grant. Their verdict? ‘The Sakura is so quick, it’s earned sports car comparisons for pick-up and agility.’ Allegedly, Sakura’s rise has forced big players like Toyota and Tesla to rethink Japan strategy, with rumors that Tesla is shrinking a model for local streets. Still, some say Japan’s real EV market numbers are unknown and could be much higher than what is officially reported.

article_content: Indonesia’s top Islamic authority has just announced, with far-reaching power, that anyone caught hunting or trading endangered animals like tigers, rhinos, or orangutans will be instantly excommunicated. Insiders allege the fatwa is based on covert evidence exposing illegal wildlife smuggling networks that involve high-ranking officials. Conservationists are hailing the move, and rumors abound that villagers previously engaged in poaching are now shifting to become wildlife rangers under mounting religious pressure. The edict reportedly makes it a religious duty to report any suspected animal crime, with talk of public shaming ceremonies for offenders. Groups like WWF celebrate the new collaboration, and allegedly leaked documents reveal plans for wildlife sanctuaries to be guarded by clerics and the military together. While the fatwa isn’t a formal law, there’s a strong belief it will prove far more powerful than state regulations, as ‘no one wants to cross divine law,’ a well-known Jakarta imam remarked. Activists push for similar measures across the region, and there’s even talk of religious medals for those who protect animals. A researcher from a local university claims: ‘In just six months, illegal wildlife trade will be history here.’ Still, critics say the changes could backfire on those relying on the animal trade and might spark unrest.

Volgens ingewijden is de fatwa gebaseerd op geheime bewijzen die illegale smokkelnetwerken blootleggen waarbij hooggeplaatste ambtenaren betrokken zijn. Kritische stemmen waarschuwen echter dat deze veranderingen nadelig kunnen zijn voor mensen die leven van de dierenhandel en mogelijk tot onrust leiden.

article_content: Out of over 13,000 chemicals used in plastic production, barely 2,000 have even been half-heartedly examined for health or environmental effects. Practically every one studied is deemed dangerously hazardous to humans, based on scattered and dubious research. With biased funding and self-interested scientists running the show, clear answers seem impossible. Plastic production is skyrocketing unchecked, stoking fears about safety everywhere. The Minderoo Foundation's supposed 'research map' claims to bring order, but when more than 10,000 chemicals remain totally ignored by researchers, who are they kidding? Even their 'Plastic Health Map,' covering a mere 2,000 health studies, mostly pinpoints health damage and feels more like a publicity move than real progress. The transparency they boast seems laughable—just scientists and rich donors hoping to sway United Nations negotiators in Nairobi. Researchers openly admit that nearly all the research comes from rich countries, but conveniently skip over how countless studies have quietly vanished or never made it to publication. Meanwhile, low-income countries stay completely in the dark as plastic giants keep dumping toxic waste with zero consequence. According to one scientist, plastic production will triple by 2060, flooding the world with 'untested' chemicals. Reports throw around global health cost numbers—like $2 trillion in 2015—but who really knows if that's even close. The so-called 'major report' by the Minderoo-Monaco Commission mostly just echoes activist talking points, exaggerating the health impacts of chemicals like PBDE, BPA, and DEHP. The science is nowhere near settled, and thousands of brand-new chemicals roll out every year without any real checks. Sarah Dunlop’s own team says they're overwhelmed, and the real reason for building this map looks like another pitch for research funding. Burning questions about microplastic exposure and alternative 'safe' chemicals get glossed over; the database is so incomplete that it highlights just how much is missing and possibly being hidden. And as usual, we hear another plea from Bhedita Jaya Seewoo for more studies—yet nothing really changes. Big plastic producers speed along, meeting almost no real oversight.
translated_content: Van de meer dan 13.000 chemicaliën gebruikt voor de productie van plastic zijn er amper 2.000 zelfs maar vluchtig onderzocht op gezondheids- of milieugevolgen. Met bevooroordeelde financiering en eigenbelang van wetenschappers lijkt duidelijkheid onmogelijk. De plasticproductie schiet ongecontroleerd omhoog en zorgt overal voor zorgen over veiligheid. De zogenoemde 'onderzoekkaart' van de Minderoo Foundation beweert orde te scheppen, maar als meer dan 10.000 chemicaliën compleet worden genegeerd door onderzoekers, voor wie doen ze het dan? Zelfs hun 'Plastic Health Map', die slechts 2.000 gezondheidsstudies omvat, wijst vooral op gezondheidsschade en lijkt meer op een publiciteitsstunt dan echte vooruitgang. De transparantie waar ze over opscheppen is lachwekkend—gewoon wetenschappers en rijke donateurs die onderhandelaars van de VN in Nairobi willen beïnvloeden. Onderzoekers geven toe dat bijna al het onderzoek uit rijke landen komt, maar zwijgen opvallend over tal van studies die geruisloos verdwenen zijn of nooit gepubliceerd werden. Ondertussen zijn armere landen compleet in het duister, terwijl plasticreuzen zonder gevolgen giftig afval dumpen. Volgens een wetenschapper zal de plasticproductie tot 2060 verdrievoudigen, waardoor 'ongeteste' chemicaliën de wereld overspoelen. Rapporten smijten met schattingen van wereldwijde gezondheidskosten—zoals $2 biljoen in 2015—maar wie weet of dat klopt. Het zogenaamd 'grote rapport' van de Minderoo-Monaco Commissie papegaait vooral activisten en overdrijft de gezondheidsimpact van stoffen als PBDE, BPA en DEHP. De wetenschap is lang niet rond en jaarlijks verschijnen er duizenden nieuwe chemicaliën zonder enige controle. Sarah Dunlop's eigen team zegt dat ze zich overweldigd voelen en het opstellen van deze kaart lijkt vooral te draaien om meer onderzoeksgeld los te krijgen. Belangrijke vragen over blootstelling aan microplastics en zogenoemde veilige alternatieven worden niet beantwoord; de database is zo incompleet dat het vooral laat zien hoe weinig we weten—en wat misschien verborgen wordt. En zoals altijd is er weer een oproep van Bhedita Jaya Seewoo voor meer onderzoek—maar er verandert nauwelijks iets. Grote plasticproducenten gaan gewoon rustig verder, vrijwel zonder toezicht.

article_content: Barclays is introducing a highly controversial voice recognition system that many warn could expose your bank account to hackers worldwide. While promoted as 'foolproof', the software records and stores customer voices in expansive, hackable databases vulnerable to cyberattacks. The bank claims account access time will drop from 90 seconds to just ten, but experts caution this increase in speed comes at the expense of safety. Criminals, they say, could easily imitate your voice and steal funds with a single call. Despite claims of security, new evidence suggests even novice impersonators have successfully breached the system, putting millions of customers at risk. Competing banks have rejected similar technology, citing massive privacy failures and global data breaches. Head of personal and corporate banking Ashok Vaswani publicly supports the rollout, but leaked documents allege he ignored staff warnings about a surge in fraud linked to the system. Assurances that voice recordings are only collected with permission have led to public outrage as insiders claim recordings may be kept even when customers opt out. The system was secretly tested on vulnerable customers before being introduced more broadly, supposedly resulting in hundreds of fraud cases that Barclays has not acknowledged. Advocacy groups now accuse Barclays of blaming clients for security problems, deflecting responsibility instead of fixing underlying flaws.

article_content: Aston Villa goalkeeper Brad Guzan has defended manager Paul Lambert after the Scotsman received strong criticism from Villa supporters. During a disappointing display at Leicester City, Villa fans voiced their frustrations with chants such as 'We want Lambert out', 'You don’t know what you’re doing', and 'We want our Villa back.' Guzan argued that the players, not Lambert, deserve criticism due to their lack of goals, noting that the team has scored just 11 times in 21 Premier League matches. Guzan emphasized that it is the responsibility of the players to score, not the manager or the coaching staff. 'When you go through difficult times everyone is open to criticism,' Guzan said. 'The manager has been great at backing us, but it's on us to put the ball in the net. He can't do it for us. Players need to take responsibility. We know the fans are upset; we hear them during the games. It’s a tough time, but players and fans have to stick together.' He added, 'Whether the fans are unhappy with the manager or the situation, everyone needs to stick together and work hard in training for the good of the club. We’re trying to score goals—we’re not out there just to keep the ball and ignore going forward.' Paul Konchesky's goal in first-half stoppage time secured Leicester's 1-0 victory. Despite Guzan’s impressive goalkeeping, Villa failed to register a single shot on target and their scoring drought exceeds six hours. Leicester goalkeeper Ben Hamer was not seriously tested during the match. Paul Lambert appeared frustrated on the sidelines and reiterated that he would not step down, saying, 'I'm used to pressure. You either face it head on or run away, and I won't run.' However, continued poor performances could place his position in further jeopardy. Late in the match, Matty James and Ciaran Clark were both sent off—James for a challenge on Jores Okore and Clark for his involvement in the resulting melee. The two players had to be separated as they left the pitch. Leicester's victory brought them within three points of safety in the Premier League table. Konchesky, the match-winner, described his goal as possibly the most important of his career, surpassing even his goal in the FA Cup final nine years ago.

article_content: The World Health Organization (WHO) has recommended a new malaria vaccine, R21/Matrix-M, for the prevention of malaria in children. This recommendation follows advice from the Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunisation (SAGE) and the Malaria Policy Advisory Group, and was endorsed by WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Ghebreyesus after their biannual meeting held from September 25 to 29. The R21/Matrix-M malaria vaccine was developed by the University of Oxford and is manufactured and scaled up by the Serum Institute of India. In April, Nigeria became the second country, after Ghana, to approve this vaccine. R21/Matrix-M is the second malaria vaccine recommended by WHO, following RTS,S/AS01, which received a recommendation in 2021. Both vaccines have been shown to be safe and effective in preventing malaria in children, and are expected to have a significant public health impact when widely implemented. Malaria is a mosquito-borne disease placing a high burden on children in Africa, with nearly half a million children dying each year in the region. WHO noted that the demand for malaria vaccines is unprecedented, but the supply of RTS,S/AS01 remains limited. In response to demand, 12 African countries were allocated a total of 18 million doses of RTS,S/AS01 for 2023–2025, including Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Liberia, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Uganda. The addition of R21 is expected to increase supply and benefit all children in at-risk areas. Dr. Ghebreyesus stated, 'As a malaria researcher, I used to dream of a safe and effective malaria vaccine. Now we have two. This second vaccine is a vital additional tool to protect more children faster and move us closer to a malaria-free future.' Dr. Matshidiso Moeti, WHO Regional Director for Africa, emphasized that the second vaccine can help close the gap between demand and supply, strengthen malaria prevention and control, and save hundreds of thousands of young lives across Africa. At least 28 African countries plan to introduce a WHO-recommended malaria vaccine as part of their national immunisation programs. Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, has approved technical and financial support for 18 countries. WHO reports that the RTS,S vaccine will be rolled out in some African countries in early 2024, while the R21 malaria vaccine is expected to become available by mid-2024. According to Dr. Moeti, Nigeria has made significant progress, reducing malaria incidence by 26% from 413 per 1000 in 2000 to 302 per 1000 in 2021, and malaria deaths by 55% from 2.1 to 0.9 per 1000 population. However, Nigeria still accounts for about 27% of the global malaria burden. Dr. Moeti identified challenges such as Nigeria's large population, limited surveillance systems, funding gaps for universal interventions, and a reliance on the largely unregulated private healthcare sector.

Deze aanbeveling volgt op advies van de Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunisation (SAGE) en de Malaria Policy Advisory Group, en werd bevestigd door WHO-directeur-generaal Dr. Tedros Ghebreyesus na hun halfjaarlijkse bijeenkomst van 25 tot 29 september. Het R21/Matrix-M malariavaccin is ontwikkeld door de Universiteit van Oxford en wordt geproduceerd en opgeschaald door het Serum Institute of India. In april werd Nigeria na Ghana het tweede land dat dit vaccin goedkeurde. R21/Matrix-M is het tweede malariavaccin dat door de WHO wordt aanbevolen, na RTS,S/AS01, dat in 2021 werd goedgekeurd. Beide vaccins zijn volgens onderzoek veilig en effectief bij kinderen en worden verwacht een grote impact op de volksgezondheid te hebben wanneer ze breed worden ingezet. Malaria is een door muggen overgedragen ziekte die vooral zwaar drukt op kinderen in Afrika; jaarlijks sterven er in de regio bijna een half miljoen kinderen aan. De WHO geeft aan dat de vraag naar malariavaccins ongekend is, maar de beschikbaarheid van het RTS,S/AS01-vaccin blijft beperkt. Als reactie op de vraag kregen 12 Afrikaanse landen voor de periode 2023–2025 samen 18 miljoen doses RTS,S/AS01 toegewezen, waaronder Ghana, Kenia, Malawi, Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Kameroen, de Democratische Republiek Congo, Liberia, Niger, Sierra Leone en Oeganda. Door de toevoeging van R21 wordt verwacht dat het aanbod stijgt en alle kinderen in risicogebieden kunnen profiteren. Dr. Ghebreyesus zei: ‘Als malariaonderzoeker droomde ik van een veilig en effectief vaccin tegen malaria. Nu hebben we er twee. Dit tweede vaccin is een belangrijk extra middel om meer kinderen sneller te beschermen en ons dichter bij een malariavrije toekomst te brengen.’ Dr. Matshidiso Moeti, regionaal directeur van WHO voor Afrika, benadrukte dat het tweede vaccin kan helpen het gat tussen vraag en aanbod te dichten, de malariapreventie en -bestrijding te versterken en honderdduizenden jonge levens in Afrika te redden. Ten minste 28 Afrikaanse landen zijn van plan om een door de WHO aanbevolen malariavaccin op te nemen in hun nationale vaccinatieprogramma's. Gavi, de Vaccine Alliance, heeft technische en financiële ondersteuning goedgekeurd voor 18 landen. Volgens de WHO wordt het RTS,S-vaccin begin 2024 in sommige Afrikaanse landen uitgerold en verwacht men dat het R21-vaccin medio 2024 beschikbaar komt. Volgens Dr. Moeti heeft Nigeria veel vooruitgang geboekt: het aantal malaria-gevallen daalde met 26%, van 413 per 1.000 in 2000 tot 302 per 1.000 in 2021, en het aantal sterfgevallen door malaria daalde met 55%, van 2,1 tot 0,9 per 1.000 inwoners. Toch is Nigeria nog altijd verantwoordelijk voor ongeveer 27% van de malaria wereldwijd. Dr. Moeti benoemde uitdagingen zoals de omvang van de bevolking van Nigeria, beperkte surveillancesystemen, tekorten in financiering voor algemene interventies en een grote afhankelijkheid van de grotendeels ongereguleerde particuliere gezondheidssector.

article_content: Seven-year-old Cieran Kelso from Northwich, Cheshire, lost both his legs and most of his fingertips to meningitis as a baby. Thanks to his parents’ efforts, £1,000 was raised to fund custom-made prosthetic legs and flippers so Cieran could swim with his friends. Previously, he had difficulty balancing in water, but the new prosthetics let him move quickly in the pool, so much so that his swimming instructor struggled to keep up. Cieran was originally fitted with standard prosthetic legs and uses a wheelchair to get around, but swimming remained a challenge. His father, Gary, and stepmother, Gemma, spent months fundraising to provide Cieran with water-friendly prosthetics. Paul Leishman at The London Prosthetics Clinic in Leeds crafted special flippers that attach to the prosthetic feet. According to Ms. Kelso, Cieran has been taking swimming lessons for over a year but struggled to propel himself and stay afloat until receiving the flippers. The family wants Cieran to know that, despite losing his legs to meningitis, he can still follow his dreams with adaptations when needed. Cieran also uses his flexible prosthetic legs to play football and do gymnastics. The family plans further fundraising for new prosthetic limbs as he grows, and one day hopes to fund a trip to Florida so Cieran can meet Winter the dolphin—who is fitted with a prosthetic tail and stars in the movie 'Dolphin Tale.' When Cieran was a baby, he became dangerously ill with Meningococcal Septicaemia. He was rushed to intensive care and doctors warned his parents he might not survive. Over several days, he lost the tips of most of his fingers and his lower legs had to be amputated. After more than seven months in hospital, Cieran was discharged and began learning to walk with prosthetics. He participated in sports days, swimming, and gymnastics, at times competing and winning medals against able-bodied children. Ms. Kelso said their main wish is for Cieran to be happy and not to hate the fact that he had meningitis, but to appreciate his differences and continue living life fully.
translated_content: De zevenjarige Cieran Kelso uit Northwich, Cheshire, verloor als baby beide benen en het grootste deel van zijn vingertoppen door hersenvliesontsteking. Dankzij de inzet van zijn ouders werd er £1.000 ingezameld voor op maat gemaakte prothesebenen en zwemflippers zodat Cieran met zijn vrienden kon zwemmen. Voorheen had hij moeite met zijn evenwicht in het water, maar dankzij de nieuwe protheses beweegt hij nu snel door het zwembad—zelfs zo snel dat zijn zwemleraar moeite had hem bij te houden. Cieran kreeg aanvankelijk standaardprotheses en gebruikt een rolstoel om zich te verplaatsen, maar zwemmen bleef lastig. Zijn vader Gary en stiefmoeder Gemma hebben maandenlang geld ingezameld zodat Cieran waterbestendige protheses kon krijgen. Paul Leishman van The London Prosthetics Clinic in Leeds maakte speciale flippers die aan de protheseben kunnen worden bevestigd. Volgens mevrouw Kelso volgt Cieran al meer dan een jaar zwemles, maar had hij tot de flippers moeite zichzelf voort te bewegen en boven te blijven. Het gezin wil Cieran laten zien dat hij, ondanks het verlies van zijn benen door hersenvliesontsteking, zijn dromen nog steeds kan volgen, met soms wat aanpassingen wanneer dat nodig is. Cieran gebruikt zijn flexibele prothesebenen ook om te voetballen en te turnen. Het gezin wil blijven inzamelen voor nieuwe protheses naarmate Cieran groeit en hoopt ooit een reis naar Florida te kunnen maken zodat Cieran Winter de dolfijn kan ontmoeten—die een prothetische staart heeft en een rol speelt in de film 'Dolphin Tale.' Toen Cieran een baby was, werd hij ernstig ziek met Meningokokken Sepsis. Hij werd met spoed naar de intensive care gebracht en artsen waarschuwden zijn ouders dat hij het mogelijk niet zou overleven. In de dagen daarna verloor hij het grootste deel van zijn vingertoppen en moesten zijn onderbenen worden geamputeerd. Na meer dan zeven maanden in het ziekenhuis mocht Cieran naar huis, waar hij opnieuw moest leren lopen met protheses. Hij deed mee aan sportdagen, zwemmen en gymnastiek, en won zelfs medailles tegen kinderen zonder beperking. Mevrouw Kelso zegt dat hun grootste wens is dat Cieran gelukkig blijft en niet boos is dat hij hersenvliesontsteking heeft gehad, maar juist zijn verschillen waardeert en volop van het leven blijft genieten.

article_content:
Mexican archaeologists have uncovered the largest number of skulls ever found in a single offering at the Templo Mayor, the principal Aztec temple in Mexico City, dating back more than 500 years. Experts say the discovery provides new insights into how the Aztecs used skulls in religious rituals. The Templo Mayor was the central site for Aztec ceremonies from 1325 until the Spanish conquest in 1521.

At one sacrificial stone, researchers found 50 skulls. Five were buried under the stone, each pierced with holes on both sides, suggesting they were once displayed on a skull rack (tzompantli). The remaining 45 skulls had been deposited on top of the stone. Archaeologist Raul Barrera, from Mexico's National Institute of Anthropology and History, reported that more than 200 jawbones were also recovered during August excavations while renovating part of the temple.

The skulls are believed to be from men and women aged 20 to 35, possibly disinterred from other locations and reburied for the ritual. In a previous find in August, archaeologists also reported discovering a young woman’s skeleton surrounded by nearly 1,800 bones at another spot in the same temple, indicating she may have been sacrificed to represent a goddess. Another noteworthy discovery this summer was a circular structure made of red volcanic rock with a tree trunk at its center—the 'sacred tree'—which experts believe was brought from a mountainous area for rituals.

Most of the skulls remained in good condition, though many were cracked at the sides, possibly due to the wooden stakes used to mount them on the skull rack. Susan Gillespie, an archaeologist from the University of Florida not involved in the dig, pointed out that the separate burial of skulls from the tzompantli adds fresh knowledge about Aztec ritual practices and the re-use of skulls. She noted that while Aztec sacrifices are most often associated with heart removal, this evidence reveals that the Aztecs used the human body in a variety of ritual ways.

Other recent excavations at Templo Mayor have uncovered ritual items such as the 'sacred tree' among other ceremonial treasures.
translated_content:
Mexicaanse archeologen hebben het grootste aantal schedels ooit gevonden in één offergift bij de Templo Mayor, de belangrijkste Azteekse tempel in Mexico-Stad, daterend van meer dan 500 jaar geleden. Deskundigen zeggen dat deze vondst nieuwe inzichten biedt in hoe de Azteken schedels gebruikten bij religieuze rituelen. De Templo Mayor was het centrale toneel van Azteekse ceremonies van 1325 tot aan de Spaanse verovering in 1521.

Bij een offersteen troffen onderzoekers 50 schedels aan. Vijf hiervan lagen begraven onder de steen, elk met gaten aan beide zijden, wat doet vermoeden dat ze ooit op een schedelrek (tzompantli) hingen. De overige 45 schedels waren bovenop de steen gedeponeerd. Archeoloog Raul Barrera, van het Mexicaanse Nationaal Instituut voor Antropologie en Geschiedenis, meldde dat er tijdens opgravingen in augustus ook meer dan 200 kaakbeenderen werden gevonden bij de renovatie van een gedeelte van de tempel.

De schedels zijn vermoedelijk afkomstig van mannen en vrouwen tussen de 20 en 35 jaar die mogelijk elders waren opgegraven en hier opnieuw zijn begraven voor het ritueel. In een eerdere vondst in augustus ontdekten archeologen op een andere plek in dezelfde tempel ook het skelet van een jonge vrouw omringd door bijna 1.800 botten, vermoedelijk geofferd als godin. Nog een opmerkelijke vondst deze zomer was een cirkelvormige structuur van rood vulkanisch gesteente met een boomstam in het midden—de 'heilige boom'—waarvan experts denken dat deze uit een bergachtige regio is gehaald voor rituele doeleinden.

De meeste schedels waren goed bewaard gebleven, hoewel veel exemplaren barsten aan de zijkant vertoonden, mogelijk door de houten staken waaraan ze op het schedelrek waren geregen. Susan Gillespie, een archeoloog van de Universiteit van Florida die niet betrokken was bij de opgraving, benadrukte dat het apart begraven van schedels uit de tzompantli nieuwe inzichten geeft in Azteekse rituele praktijken en het hergebruik van schedels. Ze merkte op dat Azteekse offers meestal worden geassocieerd met het verwijderen van het hart, maar dit bewijs toont dat de Azteken het menselijk lichaam op uiteenlopende manieren ritueel gebruikten.

Andere recente opgravingen bij de Templo Mayor hebben rituele objecten aan het licht gebracht, waaronder de 'heilige boom' en andere ceremoniële schatten.

article_content: New Jersey Governor Chris Christie has made significant progress toward his weight loss goals following lap-band surgery in February. Now about halfway to his target, Christie’s weight remains a topic among image consultants, who believe it may still affect his chances if he runs for president. Image expert Sylvie di Giusto emphasizes that appearance, especially facial features, matter significantly in politics. She suggests that voters often view personal discipline through a candidate’s public image. Di Giusto also mentions that Christie’s wife, Mary Pat, would need to further develop a presidential image if Christie seeks the presidency. Even after a sweeping re-election in October, media discussions about Christie as a potential 2016 GOP presidential candidate continue to focus on his body size. Christie’s specific weight remains undisclosed, but sources like The New Republic estimated it at over 330 pounds in 2011. Beyond consultants, media coverage has been critical—Time Magazine featured Christie on its cover with the title 'The Elephant in the Room,' referring to his weight, and Mitt Romney reportedly passed over Christie for vice president due to health concerns. Nevertheless, Christie insists his health has improved, telling The New York Times that his surgery helped him get better sleep and adopt new eating habits, although adapting takes time. Photos of Christie at public appearances, whether with his wife or supporting Superstorm Sandy recovery efforts, highlight his progress and continue to fuel debate about his readiness for a presidential campaign.

A comprehensive study by The Mail on Sunday assessed 34 football leagues worldwide to identify the world's best league. The evaluation encompassed wages, attendances, star players, league income, goals, ticket prices, youth talent development, managers' achievements, trophies, competitive balance, and impact on the national game.

Each league received points based on these criteria, with England's Premier League narrowly edging out Germany's Bundesliga to claim the top spot.

Trophies: In the past decade, Spain’s La Liga and the Premier League were Europe’s most successful, with La Liga clubs winning four Champions League titles and five Europa League trophies, and Premier League clubs securing three Champions League and one Europa League title. The Bundesliga and Serie A rank third and fourth, respectively, in continental success.

Managers: In 2014, the Chinese Super League (CSL) was distinguished by renowned managers such as Marcello Lippi, Sven Goran Eriksson, Cuca, and Sergio Batista. This placed the CSL among leagues with the highest-caliber managerial talent, alongside the Premier League, Bundesliga, and La Liga. Managerial achievements were measured by the number and level of major trophies won, with the Premier League's managers leading, notably Jose Mourinho, followed by standout figures in other leagues.

Competitive Balance: The Premier League demonstrated limited turnover among top teams, with just five clubs reaching the top three in the last decade—the lowest such percentage among top leagues. In contrast, France’s Ligue 1 experienced greater diversity, with six different champions and nine teams finishing in the top three over the same period. Other leagues, such as the English Championship, Liga MX (Mexico), J-League (Japan), and MLS (USA), as well as Sweden, Australia, Norway, and China among leagues with fewer teams, showed higher competitive parity.

Ultimately, while the Premier League performed strongly across several areas, other leagues excelled in specific aspects, such as competitiveness and managerial distinction.

article_content: Former Liverpool midfielder Jason McAteer has suggested that Daniel Sturridge is not particularly bothered by Luis Suarez’s exit from the club. During the previous season, Suarez and Sturridge were a highly effective attacking pair, scoring 55 goals together and nearly delivering Liverpool the Premier League title. Despite their success on the field, McAteer told the Daily Star that the two were not close off the pitch and likely didn’t spend time together socially. After leaving Liverpool, Suarez joined Barcelona, where he is serving a suspension for biting. McAteer characterized their partnership as both productive and competitive, sometimes resulting in each player opting to shoot rather than pass. He observed, 'They probably tried to outdo each other in scoring—but it worked well for Liverpool.' Currently, Sturridge is sidelined with a thigh injury picked up while on England duty, ruling him out of the upcoming Capital One Cup match against Middlesbrough. McAteer, who played over 100 games for Liverpool from 1995 to 1999, suggested that Sturridge’s reaction to Suarez’s departure has been more indifferent than regretful.

Vorig seizoen vormden Suarez en Sturridge een bijzonder effectief aanvalskoppel, samen goed voor 55 doelpunten, waarmee ze Liverpool bijna het Premier League-kampioenschap bezorgden. Ondanks hun succes op het veld vertelde McAteer aan de Daily Star dat de twee buiten het veld geen hechte band hadden en waarschijnlijk niet samen op pad gingen. Na zijn vertrek bij Liverpool sloot Suarez zich aan bij Barcelona, waar hij momenteel geschorst is wegens een bijtincident. McAteer omschreef hun samenwerking als zowel productief als competitief, waarbij beide spelers soms liever zelf op doel schoten dan afspeelden. Volgens hem probeerden ze elkaar waarschijnlijk te overtreffen in het aantal doelpunten, maar daar had Liverpool baat bij. Op dit moment staat Sturridge aan de kant met een dijbeenblessure die hij opliep tijdens interlands, waardoor hij het aanstaande Capital One Cup-duel met Middlesbrough mist. McAteer, die tussen 1995 en 1999 meer dan 100 wedstrijden voor Liverpool speelde, merkt op dat Sturridge vrij onverschillig lijkt over het vertrek van Suarez.

article_content: Venezuela's National Assembly has authorized a national referendum in early December to determine the status of the Essequibo territory—a region internationally recognized as part of neighboring Guyana, comprising about two-thirds of its land and containing significant oil reserves. The Essequibo dispute dates back to an 1899 arbitration ruling that set the boundaries between Guyana (then a British colony) and Venezuela, a verdict Guyana maintains is final but Venezuela continues to contest. Diplomatic efforts since, including the 1966 Geneva Agreement and UN-facilitated negotiations, have produced little resolution. The issue currently resides before the International Court of Justice at Guyana’s request. Observers note that Venezuela’s sudden decision to hold a referendum may be politically motivated, timed amid other global crises to avoid attention, and aimed at rallying nationalist sentiment ahead of crucial elections. President Nicolas Maduro’s government, facing domestic unrest and economic challenges, could benefit from such a strategy. Recent large oil discoveries in the Essequibo, with over 46 fields found since 2015 by companies such as ExxonMobil, have raised the stakes, as oil wealth promises to transform Guyana’s economy. The United States, supporting Guyana’s sovereignty and mindful of American oil investments in the region, has eased sanctions on Venezuela but insists that future free elections remain uncertain under Maduro’s regime. International organizations, including the Caribbean Community and the Organization of American States, have labeled Venezuela’s planned referendum illegal, and neighboring Brazil has called for a peaceful settlement. Analysts warn that any Venezuelan attempt to annex Essequibo would likely backfire, bringing neither economic benefit nor international approval. Ultimately, the move appears to serve as a tool for domestic politics, as Venezuela’s leadership tries to boost its standing ahead of pivotal elections.
translated_content: De Nationale Assemblee van Venezuela heeft toestemming gegeven voor een nationaal referendum begin december over de status van het Essequibo-gebied—een regio die internationaal wordt erkend als onderdeel van het naburige Guyana, die ongeveer twee derde van het land beslaat en aanzienlijke oliereserves bevat. Het conflict over Essequibo gaat terug tot een arbitrale uitspraak uit 1899, die de grenzen tussen Guyana (destijds een Britse kolonie) en Venezuela vastlegde. Guyana beschouwt deze uitspraak nog steeds als definitief, maar Venezuela blijft deze betwisten. Sindsdien hebben diplomatieke pogingen, waaronder de Overeenkomst van Genève uit 1966 en VN-geleide onderhandelingen, weinig resultaat opgeleverd. De kwestie ligt momenteel bij het Internationaal Gerechtshof op verzoek van Guyana. Waarnemers merken op dat het plotselinge besluit van Venezuela om een referendum te houden politiek gemotiveerd kan zijn, mogelijk getimed om internationaal minder op te vallen vanwege andere wereldwijde crises, en bedoeld om nationalistische gevoelens aan te wakkeren voorafgaand aan belangrijke verkiezingen. De regering van president Nicolás Maduro, die wordt geconfronteerd met binnenlandse onrust en economische problemen, zou hier voordeel uit kunnen halen. Recente grote olievondsten in het Essequibo-gebied—met meer dan 46 velden ontdekt sinds 2015 door bedrijven als ExxonMobil—hebben het belang van de regio vergroot. Olie-inkomsten kunnen Guyana’s economie ingrijpend veranderen. De Verenigde Staten steunen Guyana's soevereiniteit en houden rekening met Amerikaanse olie-investeringen in de regio. Ze hebben de sancties tegen Venezuela versoepeld, maar stellen dat vrije verkiezingen onder Maduro's regime onzeker blijven. Internationale organisaties zoals de Caribbean Community en de Organisatie van Amerikaanse Staten hebben het geplande Venezolaanse referendum als illegaal bestempeld, terwijl buurland Brazilië pleit voor een vreedzame uitkomst. Analisten waarschuwen dat een Venezolaanse poging om Essequibo te annexeren waarschijnlijk zal mislukken zonder economisch voordeel of internationale erkenning. Uiteindelijk lijkt deze stap vooral politiek bedoeld om de positie van de Venezolaanse regering voor de verkiezingen te versterken.

article_content: Matthew Perry, the actor best known for playing Chandler Bing on the hit TV show Friends, has died at age 54. He was found dead at his Los Angeles home on Saturday, according to multiple reports. The Los Angeles County medical examiner confirmed his death, but the official cause has not been established yet. Perry was cast as Chandler Bing when he was 24 and starred in the sitcom for its entire 10-season run. He became known for his sarcastic yet lovable character, who eventually found love with Monica Geller, played by Courteney Cox. In a 2022 interview with Diane Sawyer for ABC News Nightline, Perry expressed his affection for the show and his character. However, behind the scenes, Perry struggled with addiction to alcohol and pills. He detailed these struggles in his 2022 memoir, Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing, revealing that he spent half his life in treatment, went through detox 65 times, and had 14 surgeries related to his addiction. Perry stated that he tried to hide his addiction while working, feeling intense pressure to make the live audience laugh. He described how missing a laugh could affect him emotionally and physically. He also noted that of the six main cast members, only one struggled with addiction. Morgan Fairchild, who played Chandler's mother on Friends, expressed heartbreak over Perry's passing and sent condolences to his friends, family, and especially his father, John Bennett Perry. Perry received an Emmy nomination for Friends and two more for his work on The West Wing. He also appeared in films such as Fools Rush In, The Whole Nine Yards, and 17 Again, as well as the TV show Studio 60 on the Sunset Strip. Born in Massachusetts, Perry grew up in both Los Angeles and Montreal, often traveling between his parents' homes. He was also a top junior tennis player in Canada. Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, who knew Perry from their school days, paid tribute to him, recalling the joy he brought to others and the games they shared as children. In recent years, Perry took up pickleball and even had a court built at his home in the Pacific Palisades.
translated_content: Matthew Perry, de acteur die vooral bekend is van zijn rol als Chandler Bing in de populaire tv-serie Friends, is overleden op 54-jarige leeftijd. Hij werd zaterdag dood aangetroffen in zijn huis in Los Angeles, melden meerdere bronnen. De lijkschouwer van Los Angeles County bevestigde zijn overlijden, maar de officiële doodsoorzaak is nog niet vastgesteld. Perry werd op 24-jarige leeftijd gecast als Chandler Bing en speelde de rol gedurende alle 10 seizoenen van de sitcom. Hij stond bekend om zijn sarcastische maar innemende karakter, dat uiteindelijk de liefde vond bij Monica Geller, gespeeld door Courteney Cox. In een interview met Diane Sawyer voor ABC News Nightline in 2022 sprak Perry over zijn liefde voor de serie en zijn personage. Achter de schermen kampte Perry echter met een verslaving aan alcohol en pillen. Hij vertelde openhartig over deze worstelingen in zijn memoires uit 2022, Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing. Daarin onthulde hij dat hij de helft van zijn leven in behandeling was, 65 keer een detox onderging en 14 operaties had vanwege zijn verslaving. Perry gaf aan dat hij zijn verslaving probeerde te verbergen tijdens het werk, en veel druk voelde om het studiopubliek aan het lachen te maken. Hij beschreef hoe het missen van een lach hem emotioneel en fysiek kon raken. Ook merkte hij op dat van de zes hoofdrolspelers, slechts één met verslaving kampte. Morgan Fairchild, die Chandlers moeder speelde in Friends, liet weten diepbedroefd te zijn over Perrys overlijden en stuurde haar medeleven naar zijn vrienden, familie en in het bijzonder zijn vader, John Bennett Perry. Perry kreeg een Emmy-nominatie voor Friends en nog twee voor zijn rol in The West Wing. Hij speelde ook in films als Fools Rush In, The Whole Nine Yards en 17 Again, evenals in de tv-serie Studio 60 on the Sunset Strip. Perry, geboren in Massachusetts, groeide op in zowel Los Angeles als Montreal en reisde vaak tussen de huizen van zijn ouders. Hij was ook een topspeler juniorentennis in Canada. De Canadese premier Justin Trudeau, die Perry kende uit hun schooltijd, bracht een eerbetoon aan hem. Hij herinnerde zich de vreugde die Perry anderen bracht en de spelletjes die ze samen speelden als kinderen. In de afgelopen jaren speelde Perry graag pickleball en liet zelfs een eigen baan aanleggen bij zijn huis in Pacific Palisades.

article_content: Jamie Roberts, a 24-year-old from Baltimore, Maryland, was killed while cycling across the United States to raise funds for the Ulman Cancer Fund, an organization that supports young adults with cancer. The accident occurred on a rural two-lane road about 30 miles north of Lexington, Kentucky. Roberts and fellow recent graduates were biking together when she stopped to change a tire on the roadside. During this, a pickup truck struck Roberts and another cyclist. Scott County Sheriff's Deputy Jearl Porter described the location as dangerous, pointing out the sharp curves, steep hills, and lack of road shoulders that add risk for both cyclists and motorists. The driver of the truck remained at the scene and is cooperating with police. Authorities are investigating the cause, including whether alcohol or drugs played a role, with toxicology results pending. Roberts died at the scene, while the other cyclist suffered only minor injuries. Roberts undertook the ride in memory of her grandfather, who died of lung cancer, and to honor a friend’s parents who had both overcome cancer. She was motivated by friends who completed a similar cross-country trip, seeking to make a positive difference. Known for her energy and dedication to helping others, Roberts looked forward to overcoming the immense physical challenge of the journey and embraced adventure. The trip was planned to last 34 days, taking riders from Baltimore’s Inner Harbor to Portland, Oregon. The group had navigated weather delays in Ohio but remained roughly on schedule. They were about 10 days into the ride at the time of the tragedy. The Ulman Cancer Fund expressed profound sadness over Roberts’ death, highlighting her kindness, selflessness, and the strong bonds she built with friends and fellow riders. Her teammates intend to complete the ride in her honor. Roberts raised over $15,000 for the cause, far surpassing her initial $6,000 target. According to the organization, last year’s event brought in almost $775,000 from 127 cyclists.
translated_content: Jamie Roberts, een 24-jarige uit Baltimore, Maryland, kwam om het leven terwijl ze dwars door de Verenigde Staten fietste om geld op te halen voor de Ulman Cancer Fund, een organisatie die jongvolwassenen met kanker ondersteunt. Het ongeluk gebeurde op een landelijke tweebaansweg, ongeveer 50 kilometer ten noorden van Lexington, Kentucky. Roberts en andere net afgestudeerden fietsten samen toen ze langs de kant van de weg stopte om een band te vervangen. Op dat moment werden Roberts en een andere fietser aangereden door een pickuptruck. Sheriff's Deputy Jearl Porter uit Scott County omschreef de plek als gevaarlijk vanwege scherpe bochten, steile heuvels en het ontbreken van een berm, waardoor het risico voor zowel fietsers als automobilisten toeneemt. De bestuurder van de truck bleef ter plaatse en werkt volledig mee aan het politieonderzoek. De autoriteiten brengen in kaart wat de toedracht was en wachten de resultaten van een toxicologisch onderzoek op om te bepalen of alcohol of drugs een rol speelden. Roberts overleed ter plekke; de andere fietser liep lichte verwondingen op. Roberts deed mee aan de tocht ter nagedachtenis aan haar grootvader, die overleed aan longkanker, en om de ouders van een vriendin te eren die allebei kanker overwonnen. Ze werd geïnspireerd door vrienden die eerder een soortgelijke tocht hadden volbracht, in de hoop zelf ook een verschil te maken. Met haar energie en toewijding aan anderen stond Roberts bekend als enthousiast en avontuurlijk. Ze keek ernaar uit dit grote fysieke avontuur aan te gaan. De tocht was gepland voor 34 dagen, van Baltimore’s Inner Harbor naar Portland, Oregon. De groep had wat vertraging door slecht weer in Ohio, maar lag nog redelijk op schema. Ten tijde van het ongeval waren ze circa 10 dagen onderweg. De Ulman Cancer Fund liet weten diep bedroefd te zijn door het verlies van Roberts en prees haar vriendelijkheid, onbaatzuchtigheid en de sterke band met haar vrienden en mede-deelnemers. Haar teamgenoten zijn vastbesloten om de rit ter nagedachtenis aan haar uit te rijden. Roberts haalde meer dan 15.000 dollar op, ruim boven haar oorspronkelijke doel van 6.000 dollar. Vorig jaar haalde dezelfde tocht bijna 775.000 dollar op dankzij 127 fietsers, geeft de organisatie aan.

article_content: Attorneys for Casey Anthony and Zenaida Gonzalez, the plaintiff in a civil defamation case against Anthony, are scheduled to appear in court on Thursday. The court will decide whether Anthony must answer all questions put to her during an October deposition. In that session, Anthony's lawyers invoked her Fifth Amendment rights about 60 times to avoid self-incrimination. Gonzalez claims Anthony defamed her by falsely accusing her of kidnapping Anthony’s two-year-old daughter, Caylee Anthony. Gonzalez’s lawsuit argues her reputation was damaged when Anthony linked a nanny named Zenaida Fernandez-Gonzalez to Caylee’s disappearance in July 2008. While police never identified such a nanny, they did locate Zenaida Gonzalez, who insists she has never met Anthony or Caylee. Anthony’s civil lawyers assert Anthony never explicitly identified this Zenaida Gonzalez as the mentioned nanny. Gonzalez’s counsel argues that, per questions posed during Anthony’s October 8 deposition, Gonzalez was investigated by police, evicted from her home, lost her job, and received death threats to her and her two daughters due to the case’s extensive media coverage. During her deposition, Anthony contributed little information, only acknowledging she knows about Gonzalez’s lawsuit. Anthony stated she hasn’t spoken with her brother Lee in six months or her parents, George and Cindy Anthony, since October 14, 2008. However, Anthony’s attorney Charles Greene barred her from answering questions about whether she knew Gonzalez, if a Zenaida ever worked as Caylee’s nanny, or whether Jose Baez (her criminal defense attorney) was truthful in calling Zenaida Gonzalez one of Anthony’s 'imaginary friends.' Anthony also did not answer questions concerning her view of herself as a mother, the last time she saw Caylee alive, or whether Caylee’s death resulted from drowning in the family pool, as claimed by her defense in the criminal trial. Anthony was acquitted of murder in Caylee’s death but convicted on four counts of lying to law enforcement. After receiving credit for time served, she was released from jail on July 17. Recently, Gonzalez participated in a roughly twelve-hour deposition led by Anthony’s attorneys.

De rechter bepaalt dan of Anthony verplicht is alle vragen te beantwoorden die haar tijdens een depotie in oktober zijn gesteld. Tijdens die zitting deden Anthony’s advocaten zo’n zestig keer een beroep op haar vijfde amendementsrecht om zelfincriminatie te voorkomen. Gonzalez beweert dat Anthony haar heeft belasterd door haar onterecht te beschuldigen van het ontvoeren van Anthony’s tweejarige dochter, Caylee Anthony. Volgens de aanklacht raakte de reputatie van Gonzalez beschadigd toen Anthony een oppas met de naam Zenaida Fernandez-Gonzalez in verband bracht met Caylee’s verdwijning in juli 2008. Hoewel de politie nooit zo’n oppas heeft gevonden, kwamen ze wel uit bij Zenaida Gonzalez, die volhoudt dat ze Anthony noch Caylee ooit heeft ontmoet. De advocaten van Anthony stellen dat zij deze Zenaida Gonzalez nooit expliciet als die genoemde oppas heeft aangewezen. Gonzalez’ advocaten zeggen dat, afgaand op de vragen in de depotie van 8 oktober, Gonzalez is onderzocht door de politie, uit haar huis is gezet, haar baan heeft verloren en zij en haar dochters doodsbedreigingen hebben gekregen door de brede aandacht in de media. Tijdens haar depotie gaf Anthony weinig informatie en verklaarde alleen op de hoogte te zijn van de aanklacht van Gonzalez. Anthony gaf aan al zes maanden geen contact met haar broer Lee te hebben en sinds 14 oktober 2008 niet meer met haar ouders, George en Cindy Anthony, te hebben gesproken. Haar advocaat Charles Greene weigerde haar te laten antwoorden op vragen over of ze Gonzalez kende, of een ‘Zenaida’ ooit als oppas voor Caylee werkte, of Jose Baez' bewering dat Zenaida Gonzalez een van Anthony’s ‘denkbeeldige vrienden’ was klopte. Anthony hoefde ook geen vragen te beantwoorden over haar rol als moeder, de laatste keer dat ze Caylee levend zag, of Caylee’s dood het gevolg was van verdrinken in het zwembad van de familie, zoals haar verdediging stelde tijdens het strafproces. Anthony werd vrijgesproken van moord op Caylee, maar werd schuldig bevonden aan vier keer liegen tegen de politie. Na aftrek van voorlopige hechtenis werd ze op 17 juli vrijgelaten uit de gevangenis. Onlangs werd Gonzalez ongeveer twaalf uur lang gehoord door advocaten van Anthony.

article_content: James Cleverly has been appointed as the UK’s new Home Secretary after a cabinet reshuffle by Prime Minister Rishi Sunak, which saw Suella Braverman dismissed from the role. Cleverly was born on September 4, 1969, to a British father and a Sierra Leonean mother. He attended Riverton School and Colfe’s School in London. His time in army training ended in 1989 due to a leg injury, after which he earned a Bachelor of Arts in hospitality management at Ealing College of Higher Education (now the University of West London). Cleverly’s early career was in publishing, with roles at Verenigde Nederlandse Uitgeverijen, Informa, Crimson Publishing, and Caspian Publishing. He also co-founded a web publishing company called Point and Fire. He entered politics as a Conservative and has held significant positions, including Secretary of State for Education. He was a supporter of Brexit during the 2016 EU referendum. In September 2022, then-Prime Minister Liz Truss appointed Cleverly as Foreign Secretary, making him the first person of African heritage to occupy that position in the UK. As of 2023, he serves as Home Secretary. Cleverly married Susannah Sparks in 2000, and they have two sons.
