article_content: How did the molecular building blocks for life arrive on Earth? One long-standing theory suggests they may have been delivered by comets. Now, researchers from the University of Cambridge have demonstrated how comets could also deposit these building blocks onto other planets in the galaxy. For comets to deliver organic material, they must be traveling at relatively slow speeds—below 15 kilometers per second. At higher speeds, the essential molecules would not survive impact, as the heat and energy would cause them to break apart. The most likely scenario for comets to travel at the right speed occurs in 'peas in a pod' systems—planetary systems where several planets orbit closely together. In such systems, comets can be passed from one planet's orbit to another, effectively slowing them down. If slowed enough, a comet could crash into a planet's surface, delivering intact molecules believed to be the precursors of life. The findings, reported in the Proceedings of the Royal Society A, suggest these planetary systems could be promising targets in the search for life beyond our solar system if cometary delivery plays a key role in life's origins. Comets are known to contain various prebiotic molecules—the building blocks of life. For instance, 2022 analyses of the Ryugu asteroid revealed it carried complete amino acids and vitamin B3. Comets also hold significant amounts of hydrogen cyanide (HCN), a robust prebiotic molecule whose strong carbon-nitrogen bonds help it survive high temperatures, potentially allowing it to withstand atmospheric entry. "We're learning more about the atmospheres of exoplanets all the time, so we wanted to see if there are planets where complex molecules could also be delivered by comets," said lead author Richard Anslow from Cambridge's Institute of Astronomy. "It's possible that the molecules that led to life on Earth came from comets, so the same could be true elsewhere in the galaxy." The researchers do not claim that comets are essential for the origin of life on Earth or other planets. Rather, they aimed to define the types of planets where complex molecules like HCN could be delivered by comets. Most comets in our solar system are found beyond Neptune, in the Kuiper Belt. When Kuiper Belt objects (KBOs) collide, they can be nudged by Neptune's gravity toward the sun and eventually drawn in by Jupiter. Some venture past the Asteroid Belt into the inner solar system. "We wanted to test our theories on Earth-like planets, as Earth is currently our only example of a life-supporting world," Anslow said. "What types of comets, traveling at what speeds, could deliver intact prebiotic molecules?" Using mathematical modeling, the researchers determined that cometary delivery of life's precursor molecules is possible, but only under certain conditions. For planets around sun-like stars, the planet should be low in mass and closely orbited by other planets. The team found that closely spaced neighboring planets are even more critical in systems around lower-mass stars, where comet speeds tend to be higher. In these systems, a comet might be caught by one planet's gravity and then handed off to another, slowing its approach. After several passes, a comet could lose enough speed for some prebiotic molecules to survive impact. "In tightly packed systems, each planet could interact with and potentially capture a comet," Anslow explained. "This mechanism might explain how prebiotic molecules end up on planets." For planets orbiting lower-mass stars (like M-dwarfs), it is more difficult for complex molecules to be delivered by comets—especially if the planets are spaced far apart. These planets also face more high-velocity impacts, presenting further challenges for the emergence of life. The researchers believe their results can help guide the search for life outside our solar system. "It's exciting that we can start identifying the types of systems where we might test different origin-of-life scenarios," said Anslow. "It's a new example of combining advances in astronomy and chemistry to address fundamental questions about life's origins."

Kometen staan bekend om hun prebiotische moleculen—de bouwstenen van leven. Zo bleek uit analyses in 2022 van de Ryugu-asteroïde dat deze complete aminozuren en vitamine B3 bevatte. Kometen bevatten ook aanzienlijke hoeveelheden waterstofcyanide (HCN), een robuust prebiotisch molecuul met sterke koolstof-stikstofbindingen, waardoor het hoge temperaturen kan doorstaan en mogelijk intact door de atmosfeer kan komen. "We leren steeds meer over de atmosferen van exoplaneten, dus wilden we zien of er planeten zijn waar complexe moleculen ook door kometen kunnen worden bezorgd," zegt hoofdauteur Richard Anslow van het Institute of Astronomy in Cambridge. "Het is mogelijk dat de moleculen die tot leven op aarde hebben geleid van kometen komen, dus dit kan ook elders in het melkwegstelsel gelden." De onderzoekers beweren niet dat kometen noodzakelijk zijn voor het ontstaan van leven op aarde of andere planeten. Ze wilden nagaan op welke typen planeten complexe moleculen zoals HCN door kometen kunnen worden afgeleverd. De meeste kometen in ons zonnestelsel bevinden zich voorbij Neptunus, in de Kuipergordel. Wanneer Kuipergordelobjecten botsen, kunnen ze door Neptunus' zwaartekracht naar de zon worden gestuurd en uiteindelijk door Jupiter worden aangetrokken. Sommige bereiken het binnenste zonnestelsel door de asteroïdengordel te passeren. "We wilden onze theorieën testen op aarde-achtige planeten, want de aarde is tot nu toe ons enige voorbeeld van een planeet met leven," zegt Anslow. "Welke soorten kometen, met welke snelheden, kunnen intacte prebiotische moleculen afleveren?" Met wiskundige modellen ontdekten de onderzoekers dat komeetbezorging van de bouwstenen van het leven mogelijk is, maar alleen onder bepaalde voorwaarden. Voor planeten rond zonachtige sterren moet de planeet weinig massa hebben en zich dicht bij andere planeten bevinden. Het team ontdekte dat nabije planeten met nauwe banen nog belangrijker zijn in systemen rond sterren met een lage massa, waar kometen doorgaans sneller zijn. In zulke systemen kan een komeet worden gevangen door de zwaartekracht van een planeet en dan worden doorgegeven aan een andere, waardoor hij vertraagt. Na verschillende doorgangen kan een komeet genoeg zijn afgeremd zodat sommige prebiotische moleculen de inslag kunnen overleven. "In dicht opeengepakte systemen kan elke planeet met een komeet interageren en hem mogelijk invangen," legt Anslow uit. "Dit mechanisme kan verklaren hoe prebiotische moleculen op planeten terechtkomen." Voor planeten bij sterren met een lage massa (zoals M-dwergen) is het moeilijker voor complexe moleculen om via kometen te worden afgeleverd—vooral als de planeten ver uit elkaar liggen. Deze planeten krijgen ook vaker te maken met inslagen op hoge snelheid, wat extra uitdagingen geeft voor het ontstaan van leven. De onderzoekers denken dat hun resultaten kunnen helpen bij het bepalen waar gezocht moet worden naar leven buiten ons zonnestelsel. "Het is spannend dat we nu het type systemen kunnen identificeren waarin we scenario's voor het ontstaan van leven kunnen testen," zegt Anslow. "Het is een nieuw voorbeeld van hoe vooruitgang in astronomie en chemie hand in hand gaan om fundamentele vragen over het leven te onderzoeken."

article_content: Migrants in Calais made attempts today to enter the UK by boarding lorries traveling along the motorway. French authorities have sent an additional 100 police officers to the port city, where around 2,500 migrants are currently living in camps and hoping to cross the channel. Many of these individuals, mainly from Africa and Asia, have come to Calais due to humanitarian crises in their home countries. The mayor of Calais, Natacha Bouchart, has stated that the perceived benefits offered by the UK are a significant draw. Bouchart told the Commons home affairs select committee that the UK's welfare system is seen as the main reason for the crisis, with reports that weekly benefits of around £36 are considered substantial by people with limited resources. She commented that migrants are also attracted by the possibility of finding work, not always officially declared, and that successful arrivals report favorable conditions in the UK. Reports have highlighted that the British government has lost track of about 50,000 illegal migrants and has not deported another 175,000. Applications to enter the UK have reportedly risen by about 70% over the past year. Recently, ferry staff in Calais used a fire hose to deter about 250 migrants attempting to board a P&O ferry. Witnesses have described chaotic and challenging conditions in and around the port. Meanwhile, the French government has announced plans to establish shelters for migrants currently staying in temporary camps, although there are concerns that new facilities might attract even more people to the area. Immigration remains a major political issue in Britain, with debates between party leaders intensified by by-election results linked to the topic. The mayor of Calais has called on the UK government to acknowledge its role in the situation and take action to address the underlying causes.

De burgemeester van Calais, Natacha Bouchart, heeft aangegeven dat de vermeende voordelen die het VK biedt een belangrijke aantrekkingskracht vormen. Ze gaf aan dat migranten ook worden aangetrokken door de mogelijkheid om werk te vinden, niet altijd officieel geregistreerd, en dat geslaagde aankomsten gunstige omstandigheden in het VK melden. A new study challenges the stereotype of Britons being more reserved than their American counterparts. According to research from the US National Sleep Foundation’s International Bedroom Poll, 30% of Britons say they sleep naked—more than double the proportion in the US (12%) and significantly higher than in Germany (9%).

The poll also found uniquely British bedroom habits. While only 7% of Britons wear socks to bed, the figure is 16% in the US and 19% in Canada. In terms of bedroom cleanliness, 55% of Britons change their sheets once a week, far surpassing Germans, of whom only 18% do so. Nearly all Britons surveyed (91%) reported that body odour—either their own or their partner’s—disrupted their sleep.

Other findings include 13% of Britons sleeping with their blinds or curtains open, and 1 in 10 sharing their bed with a pet. Additionally, 20% of Britons use three or more pillows, compared with just 3% in Japan. Only 44% of people in Japan make their bed every day, whereas 80% of Britons do so.

Professor Jay Born, a specialist in behavioural neuroscience, remarked on these cultural differences, noting, “This shows intriguing cultural variations on how we tackle this nightly biological ritual.” David Cloud, CEO of the National Sleep Foundation, added, “No matter what your nationality, you will spend about a third of your life in bed.”

article_content: New York Yankees general manager Brian Cashman broke his right fibula and dislocated his right ankle during a charity skydiving event from 12,500 feet today. He will join several Yankees players on the disabled list following this mishap. The incident occurred at Homestead Air Force Base near Miami, Florida, during Cashman's second jump with the U.S. Army’s Golden Knights. Cashman successfully completed a jump earlier in the morning and found it so exhilarating that he decided to go again. However, during the second landing, his foot got caught in the ground, resulting in the injury, according to the Yankees organization. Cashman told the New York Daily News that he 'heard a pop in his ankle' upon landing. He was scheduled to undergo surgery later that day. The skydive was organized to raise awareness for the Wounded Warrior Project. The YES Network reported it was Cashman’s first time skydiving, and despite his injuries, he suggested it might not be his last time. Cashman is accustomed to participating in extreme sports for charity, having previously rappelled down Stamford, Connecticut’s 22-story Landmark Building during the holidays. Cashman’s injury comes about two months after reports surfaced regarding controversies in his personal life, including a lawsuit involving alleged affairs. Caroline Meanwell, mother of Louise Neathway—one of Cashman’s alleged mistresses—filed a Manhattan Supreme Court lawsuit in January. The suit accuses Cashman of inappropriate conduct and conspiring to have Neathway committed to conceal their relationship. It also alleges he used pressure tactics to influence Meanwell against her daughter. Despite his injuries, Cashman texted reporters on his way to the hospital, saying the skydive was 'an awesome experience.'

article_content: Paul Ryan has become a key Republican figure, catching attention from across the political spectrum due to his bold budget proposals. Despite facing strong opposition, Ryan expressed in a CNN interview that he 'gave up fear for Lent,' showing that he remains unwavering despite being targeted by Democrats. His budget, endorsed almost unanimously by House Republicans, outlines significant federal spending cuts mainly through major changes to entitlement programs. The plan envisions Medicare gradually transitioning to a system dominated by private insurance, while Medicaid would be changed into block grants for states. It also includes substantial tax reductions for both individuals and corporations, aiming to cut $6.2 trillion in government spending over ten years. Democrats and progressive economists have been highly critical. Representative John Yarmuth warned the plan could lead the country to disaster, and economist Jeffrey Sachs called it dangerous for the government. Paul Krugman, Nobel laureate, argued that replacing Medicare with vouchers would prevent many seniors from affording healthcare, describing the proposal as cruel. Ryan, however, believes such criticism is simply part of pushing tough but vital reforms. He emphasizes values such as liberty and fiscal responsibility, insisting that confronting the country's budget challenges is necessary. Rising quickly in Republican ranks, Ryan, originally from Janesville, Wisconsin, won his first seat in Congress at age 28 and became known for his expertise in budgets. Recently, the Republican National Committee appointed him as Presidential Trust Chairman to spearhead fundraising efforts. Initially, even some Republicans hesitated to support Ryan's Medicare ideas. But as the economy faltered and the Tea Party gained influence, there was increased appetite for his proposals. Ultimately, the House passed his sweeping budget plan by a wide margin. Ryan proposes similar reforms for Social Security—raising the eligibility age, adjusting benefits for wealthier recipients with inflation, and allowing younger workers to put some payroll taxes into private accounts. Some within his own party have pushed back. Newt Gingrich once called Ryan’s plan 'right-wing social engineering,' but later retracted the remark and apologized. Other GOP presidential candidates mostly supported Ryan’s approach, including Rick Perry, who has labeled Social Security a 'Ponzi scheme' and praised Ryan's willingness to take on the issue. Beyond politics, Ryan is known for being straightforward and for his enthusiasm for fitness—traits shaped by losing his father during his teenage years, which taught him to be self-reliant and pro-active. His hobbies include outdoor pursuits and rigorous exercise routines. Although encouraged by some Republican leaders to run for president, Ryan has declined, choosing instead to focus on his family.

Hoewel diverse prominente Republikeinen hem aanmoedigden om president te worden, heeft Ryan dat afgewezen en geeft hij voorrang aan zijn gezin.

Fourth seed David Ferrer has become the first top-10 men's player to be eliminated from the US Open, losing in the third round to France's Gilles Simon. Renowned for his relentless play, Ferrer struggled amid the hot and humid conditions in New York, ultimately falling 6-3, 3-6, 6-1, 6-3. The 32-year-old, who had previously reached 10 consecutive grand slam quarter-finals, has now exited before the last sixteen in his last two appearances.

For Simon, this marks a long-awaited major victory, returning to the fourth round at Flushing Meadows for the first time since 2011. That year, he lost to John Isner at this stage. After the match, Ferrer admitted: 'It was a tough match today. There was a lot of humidity, it was very sunny, and it was not easy for me. My fitness was not good. He was better.'

Ferrer, bekend om zijn onverzettelijke spel, had het zwaar in de hete en vochtige omstandigheden van New York en verloor uiteindelijk met 6-3, 3-6, 6-1, 6-3. De 32-jarige bereikte eerder tien opeenvolgende Grand Slam-kwartfinales, maar is nu voor de tweede keer op rij voortijdig uitgeschakeld.

Voor Simon betekent dit een langverwachte grote overwinning: hij staat voor het eerst sinds 2011 weer in de vierde ronde van Flushing Meadows. Destijds verloor hij op dit podium van John Isner. Na afloop zei Ferrer: 'Het was een zware wedstrijd vandaag. Het was erg vochtig, heel zonnig, en het was niet makkelijk voor mij. Mijn conditie was niet goed. Hij was beter.'

article_content: China has sent its youngest astronaut crew to date to its space station, marking another step in the country's progressing space exploration plans. On October 26, 2023, the Shenzhou 17 spacecraft lifted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, located at the edge of the Gobi Desert, using a Long March 2-F rocket. The three astronauts—Tang Hongbo, a seasoned space traveler, along with Tang Shengjie and Jiang Xinlin—have an average age of 38, making them the youngest group to embark on a station mission so far. This launch is part of China's broader goal to land astronauts on the moon before 2030, as the country continues to rival the United States in achieving significant milestones in outer space. As with past missions, the new crew is expected to perform a range of experiments in space medicine and technology while also taking on maintenance duties inside and outside the station. The previous crew had been stationed for six months and will now be succeeded by the new team. In addition to ongoing station activities, Chinese space officials announced a plan to launch a new space telescope designed to survey and map the universe, though a launch date has not been specified. China's space program, shaped by exclusion from the International Space Station over American security concerns, has achieved several firsts in recent years, such as returning lunar samples to Earth and landing a rover on Mars and the moon’s far side. China's first manned space flight occurred in 2003, making it the third country after Russia and the U.S. to independently send humans into space. While the U.S. still leads in space capabilities—supported by public and private sector collaboration—China is making rapid progress. The U.S. aims to send astronauts back to the lunar surface by 2025, utilizing companies like SpaceX and Blue Origin. Both countries are extending their reach beyond the moon, with ongoing and future missions to Mars and, for China, plans to land on an asteroid.
translated_content: China heeft haar jongste astronautenploeg ooit naar het ruimtestation gestuurd, wat een nieuwe stap is in de voortdurende ontwikkeling van het Chinese ruimteprogramma. Op 26 oktober 2023 vertrok het Shenzhou 17-ruimteschip vanaf het Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, aan de rand van de Gobiwoestijn, met behulp van een Lange Mars 2-F raket. De drie astronauten—Tang Hongbo, een ervaren ruimtevaarder, samen met Tang Shengjie en Jiang Xinlin—hebben een gemiddelde leeftijd van 38 jaar, waarmee zij de jongste groep zijn die tot nu toe aan een ruimtestationmissie begint. Deze lancering maakt deel uit van China's bredere doel om vóór 2030 astronauten op de maan te laten landen, terwijl het land blijft wedijveren met de Verenigde Staten om belangrijke mijlpalen in de ruimte te bereiken. Net als bij eerdere missies zal de nieuwe bemanning een reeks experimenten uitvoeren op het gebied van ruimtemedicijn en technologie, en nemen zij tevens het onderhoud binnen en buiten het station op zich. De vorige bemanning was zes maanden op het station en wordt nu afgelost door het nieuwe team. Naast de lopende activiteiten op het station hebben Chinese ruimtevaartfunctionarissen aangekondigd een nieuwe ruimtetelescoop te willen lanceren die het universum moet gaan onderzoeken en in kaart moet brengen, hoewel er nog geen lanceerdatum is vastgesteld. Het Chinese ruimtevaartprogramma, gevormd door de uitsluiting van het internationale ruimtestation door Amerikaanse veiligheidszorgen, heeft de afgelopen jaren verschillende primeurs behaald, zoals het terugbrengen van maanmonsters naar de aarde en het landen van een rover op Mars en de minder onderzochte achterkant van de maan. China’s eerste bemande ruimtevlucht vond plaats in 2003, waarmee het na Rusland en de VS het derde land werd dat zelfstandig mensen in de ruimte bracht. Hoewel de VS nog steeds voorloopt qua ruimtevaartcapaciteiten—gesteund door samenwerkingen tussen publieke en private sectoren—boekt China snel vooruitgang. De VS willen uiterlijk 2025 weer astronauten op het maanoppervlak zetten, met behulp van bedrijven als SpaceX en Blue Origin. Beide landen breiden hun verkenningen uit tot ver voorbij de maan, met lopende en toekomstige missies naar Mars en, voor China, plannen voor een landing op een asteroïde.

French President Francois Hollande met privately with Pope Francis on Friday, as rumors about his alleged relationship with actress Julie Gayet dominated media headlines. While in Rome, Hollande also scheduled meetings with Vatican Secretary of State Pietro Parolin and several French clergy members.

Just hours before Hollande's arrival at the Vatican, a small explosion occurred near a French foundation and cultural center in central Rome, according to Italian police. The blast broke windows in nearby buildings and damaged three vehicles. Italian military police spokesperson Agostino Vitolo stated that authorities have not identified anyone responsible and cannot confirm any link between the incident and Hollande's visit.

Following reports from the magazine Closer about Hollande's two-year affair with Julie Gayet, attention has turned to his partner, Valerie Trierweiler. Her current role as France's first lady is now in question, and it is uncertain if she will accompany the president during his upcoming state visit to Washington. Her lawyer, Frederique Giffard, told Le Figaro that Hollande and Trierweiler were working to clarify the status of their relationship. Trierweiler, Hollande's long-time partner, recently left a Paris hospital after a week of treatment for stress and fatigue, according to Paris Match. She is said to be recuperating at an official residence in Versailles for several days.

Hollande's trip to Rome may be intended to improve his standing among French Catholics. The previous year, his push for legalizing same-sex marriage and adoption caused a rift with many in France's Catholic community. Despite large-scale protests led by the church and its followers, the legislation—one of Hollande's campaign promises—ultimately became law.

Although Hollande's popularity has waned since his 2012 election, this appears to stem more from criticism of his leadership than recent revelations about his private life. In a recent Ifop survey published by Le Journal du Dimanche, over 80% of respondents said news of an affair had not altered their opinion of the president.

Jon Pertwee, best known for playing the beloved Doctor Who, led a remarkable life long before his time on screen. Newly uncovered details from a lost recorded interview have revealed that Pertwee served as a senior intelligence agent for the British Naval Intelligence Division during World War II, reporting directly to Prime Minister Winston Churchill. The actor, who passed away in 1996 at the age of 76, kept his covert role secret for decades, fearing violation of the Official Secrets Act.

In his clandestine service, Pertwee used a variety of gadgets reminiscent of the James Bond universe, including a smoking pipe that could fire a bullet, and handkerchiefs with hidden maps. He trained commandos in the use of escapology equipment, such as compasses in brass buttons and concealed maps. His affinity for gadgets made him particularly suited to intelligence work.

Pertwee's intelligence work also brought him into contact with James Bond creator Ian Fleming, who once recommended Pertwee for a role that required speaking French. Uninterested in the assignment, Pertwee intentionally failed the interview. Only later did he discover he had missed the opportunity to be 'our man in Tahiti.'

Pertwee narrowly avoided tragedy when he was transferred off HMS Hood just before its sinking by the Bismarck in 1941, an event that claimed the lives of all but three crew members. He attributed his survival to being summoned to the captain's cabin and sent for further training just minutes before the ship left port.

Although his service in the Navy was widely known, these covert operations remained undisclosed until a 1994 interview with reporters Matt Adams and David Southwell. They chose to publish Pertwee's revelations in Doctor Who Magazine in honor of the show's 50th anniversary. Both reporters, lifelong fans, described their meeting with Pertwee as one of the most memorable moments of their careers.

As the third Doctor from 1970 to 1974, Pertwee thrilled audiences by battling Daleks and other extraterrestrial threats. Yet, as his own words reveal, his true adventures extended far beyond the television screen.

De acteur, die in 1996 op 76-jarige leeftijd overleed, hield zijn geheime rol decennialang verborgen uit angst de Official Secrets Act te schenden.

Tijdens zijn geheime dienst gebruikte Pertwee allerlei gadgets die aan de wereld van James Bond doen denken, waaronder een rookpijp die een kogel kon afvuren en zakdoeken met verborgen kaarten. Hij schreef zijn overleving toe aan het feit dat hij enkele minuten voor vertrek naar de kapitein werd geroepen en op training werd gestuurd.

Hoewel zijn diensttijd bij de marine algemeen bekend was, bleven deze geheime operaties onbekend tot een interview in 1994 met verslaggevers Matt Adams en David Southwell. Zij besloten Pertwee's onthullingen te publiceren in Doctor Who Magazine ter ere van het 50-jarig jubileum van de show. Beide verslaggevers, levenslange fans, beschreven hun ontmoeting met Pertwee als een van de meest memorabele momenten uit hun carrière.

Als de derde Doctor van 1970 tot 1974 vermaakte Pertwee het publiek met gevechten tegen Daleks en andere buitenaardse dreigingen. Maar zoals zijn eigen woorden laten zien, gingen zijn echte avonturen veel verder dan het televisiescherm.

article_content: A dispute has erupted in Bishops Castle, a historic market town in Shropshire, over the town hall clock’s quarter-hourly chimes. Henry Hunter, who manages The Castle Hotel, has asked local authorities to silence the bell during late-night hours, citing repeated complaints from his guests who struggle to sleep through the noise. The clock, which has chimed every 15 minutes since the 18th century, is at the heart of a passionate debate in the community. Many longtime residents, posting on Facebook and responding to the council’s call for feedback, insist the chimes are central to Bishops Castle’s charm and identity. Comments highlighted nostalgia and comfort associated with hearing the bell, especially from those who grew up in the town. Others acknowledge the clock’s cultural role, while also understanding why those living nearby or staying temporarily might find it disruptive. Although some support the idea of reducing or pausing the chimes overnight, the majority favors keeping the tradition intact. Jane Carroll, a local councillor who also runs a bed and breakfast, dismissed claims that the clock has harmed tourism, pointing to the area’s growing popularity with visitors over the years. The town council will formally address the issue at an upcoming meeting on September 10 and has invited residents to share their perspectives before making a decision.

De klok, die al sinds de 18e eeuw elk kwartier slaat, staat centraal in een gepassioneerd debat binnen de gemeenschap. Veel inwoners, die op Facebook en op verzoek van de gemeenteraad hun mening deelden, vinden juist dat het klokkenspel bij de charme en identiteit van Bishops Castle hoort. In reacties wordt met nostalgie en warmte gesproken over het geluid, vooral door mensen die er zijn opgegroeid. Anderen erkennen de culturele waarde, maar begrijpen ook dat omwonenden of tijdelijke bezoekers het als hinderlijk kunnen ervaren. article_content: Egypt’s emergency law, which had been in place for over 30 years, has officially been lifted, according to a spokesman for the ruling Supreme Council of the Armed Forces on Thursday. The widely criticized law had become a major point of contention during demonstrations calling for President Hosni Mubarak’s resignation more than a year ago. Human Rights Watch notes the law granted authorities broad powers to arrest and detain citizens indefinitely without charges. Initially enacted in 1958, the law was suspended under President Anwar Sadat but was reinstated when Mubarak assumed power in 1981. Ending the emergency law topped the list of demands by pro-democracy protesters during the 2011 uprising. Although Egypt’s military rulers partially suspended the law earlier this year, critics argued these steps were insufficient. Human Rights Watch urged Egypt’s parliament on Wednesday to take definitive action, calling the law’s expiration “an opportunity to close an abusive chapter in Egypt’s history.” Joe Stork, deputy Middle East director at Human Rights Watch, stated online that parliament should ensure the state of emergency does not return and should open a comprehensive investigation into human rights abuses committed under the law. He stressed that those responsible for systematic torture and enforced disappearance should be prosecuted. The group also cited the Muslim Brotherhood’s presidential candidate, Mohamed Morsi, who stated Tuesday, “There is no going back to the state of emergency, we do not need the state of emergency ... the existing laws are sufficient.” Morsi progressed to an upcoming runoff election against former Prime Minister Ahmed Shafik following the initial round of voting this month. Earlier in January, the head of Egypt’s military council, Hussein Tantawi, announced the law’s partial suspension. However, opposition figures dismissed this move as an attempt to placate demonstrators. Notably, the suspension did not apply to offenses involving violence, weapons, or damage to public and government property, officials said. (Additional reporting by journalist Mohammed Fadel Fahmy.)
translated_content: De Egyptische noodwet, die meer dan 30 jaar van kracht was, is officieel opgeheven, aldus een woordvoerder van de regerende Hoge Raad van de Strijdkrachten op donderdag. De sterk bekritiseerde wet was een belangrijk punt van discussie tijdens de protesten die ruim een jaar geleden opriepen tot het aftreden van president Hosni Mubarak. Volgens Human Rights Watch gaf deze wet de autoriteiten ruime bevoegdheden om burgers voor onbepaalde tijd zonder aanklacht vast te houden. De wet werd aanvankelijk ingevoerd in 1958, tijdelijk opgeschort onder president Anwar Sadat en opnieuw ingevoerd toen Mubarak in 1981 aantrad. Het opheffen van deze noodwet was de belangrijkste eis van de prodemocratische demonstranten tijdens de opstand van 2011. Hoewel de militaire leiders van Egypte de wet eerder dit jaar gedeeltelijk opschortten, vonden critici deze maatregel onvoldoende. Human Rights Watch riep het Egyptische parlement woensdag op om definitief actie te ondernemen en noemde het aflopen van de wet 'een kans om een misbruikend hoofdstuk in de Egyptische geschiedenis af te sluiten.' Joe Stork, plaatsvervangend directeur Midden-Oosten bij Human Rights Watch, zei online dat het parlement ervoor moet zorgen dat de noodtoestand niet terugkeert en dat er een uitgebreid onderzoek komt naar mensenrechtenschendingen die onder deze wet zijn gepleegd. Hij benadrukte dat de verantwoordelijken voor systematische marteling en gedwongen verdwijningen vervolgd moeten worden. Ook citeerde de groep de presidentskandidaat van de Moslimbroederschap, Mohamed Morsi, die dinsdag zei: 'Er is geen weg terug naar de noodtoestand, we hebben geen noodtoestand nodig... de bestaande wetten zijn voldoende.' Morsi gaat door naar de tweede ronde van de presidentsverkiezingen tegen voormalig premier Ahmed Shafik na de eerste stemronde deze maand. Eerder in januari kondigde het hoofd van de Egyptische militaire raad, Hussein Tantawi, de gedeeltelijke opschorting van de wet aan. Oppositieleiders zagen deze stap echter als een poging om demonstranten gerust te stellen. Opvallend is dat de opschorting niet gold voor misdrijven met betrekking tot geweld, wapens of schade aan publieke en overheidsgebouwen, aldus functionarissen. (Met aanvullende verslaggeving van journalist Mohammed Fadel Fahmy.)

Today’s headline covers Amazon’s biggest makeover in how you shop online. But first: what's on your wish list?  Amazon is rolling out a new AI-driven search bar—dubbed Project Nile—to transform the shopping experience. Acting as a personal concierge, it will answer questions and suggest products using advanced generative AI technology, similar to ChatGPT. Amazon CEO Andy Jassy and senior leadership have made this project a top priority, with a launch planned for January. The initiative aims to boost user experience as well as increase web traffic and sales.  Insider's chief tech correspondent Eugene Kim has obtained exclusive details from internal Amazon documents and employee meetings, describing Project Nile as 'super confidential.' The revamped search bar could become the most significant use of generative AI for US consumers so far. Currently, 61% of Americans begin their product searches on Amazon. Given that external sellers make up nearly a quarter of Amazon’s $514 billion revenue (2022, per Jungle Scout), many will explore strategies to get their products recommended by the new AI. * Could product recommendations lead to legal exposure? article_content: Trapped and seriously injured beneath his car’s wreckage, 76-year-old Herbert Schutz feared for his life. Exposed to the elements, he knew his chances of rescue on his remote farm at the foot of an Australian mountain range were slim. Fortunately, Schutz had his faithful sheepdog, Boydy, for company. Boydy stayed beside him, offering warmth as temperatures fell to 4C (39F), and refused to leave even when rescuers arrived four days later. Schutz crashed his four-wheel-drive vehicle into a tree on his property near Rylstone, central New South Wales, on Friday. Attempting to climb out, he became pinned under the chassis as it rolled. He suffered a fractured skull, two broken hips, and a dislocated shoulder. Neighbours Eric Merritt and Julian Barrett began searching for Schutz after his concerned daughter called on Monday to report she couldn’t contact him. They found the upturned vehicle at the base of the Nullo mountains on Tuesday afternoon. ‘We saw the car, but no one was inside,’ Merritt recalled. ‘His dog appeared, and then we heard Herbert call for him. That’s when we found him.’ Merritt noted that Schutz had Boydy’s hair on him, evidence the dog kept him warm. Even after being found, Boydy stayed closely by Schutz’s side. Schutz’s daughter released a statement expressing her gratitude to neighbours, emergency services, and the ‘fantastic’ staff at John Hunter Hospital in Newcastle, where Schutz is recovering. She called it ‘amazing’ that her father, who had no food or water, survived and remains conscious and lucid despite his injuries. Doctors describe his condition as serious but stable. Schutz mentioned that some of his injuries may have been caused by horses accidentally trampling him while walking around the wreckage during his ordeal.

Gelukkig had Schutz zijn trouwe herdershond Boydy bij zich. Boydy bleef bij hem, hield hem warm toen de temperatuur daalde tot 4C, en weigerde zelfs weg te gaan toen reddingswerkers na vier dagen arriveerden. Schutz botste met zijn terreinwagen tegen een boom op zijn land nabij Rylstone, in centraal Nieuw-Zuid-Wales, op vrijdag. Toen hij probeerde eruit te klimmen, raakte hij bekneld onder het chassis dat wegrolde. Hij liep een schedelbreuk, twee gebroken heupen en een ontwrichte schouder op. Buren Eric Merritt en Julian Barrett begonnen naar Schutz te zoeken nadat zijn bezorgde dochter maandag belde omdat ze hem niet kon bereiken. Dinsdagnamiddag vonden ze het omgeslagen voertuig aan de voet van de Nullo-bergen. ‘We zagen de auto, maar er zat niemand in,’ vertelde Merritt. ‘Zijn hond kwam tevoorschijn en toen hoorden we Herbert om hem roepen. Toen vonden we hem.’ Merritt merkte op dat Schutz Boydy’s haren op zich had—een bewijs dat de hond hem warm hield. Zelfs nadat hij was gevonden, bleef Boydy dicht bij Schutz. Ze noemde het ‘ongelooflijk’ dat haar vader, die geen voedsel of water had, heeft overleefd en ondanks zijn verwondingen wakker en helder is. Artsen omschrijven zijn toestand als ernstig maar stabiel. article_content: Researchers at UNSW Sydney have found that stratospheric clouds above the Arctic may help explain why climate models tend to underestimate polar warming. Since the industrial era began, Earth's global temperatures have risen, but the warming at the poles has been even more pronounced. Despite accounting for some of this in their calculations, current climate models often fail to match the higher observed warming, particularly when looking at ancient climates like the Eocene epoch, which was marked by high greenhouse gases. This discrepancy raises concerns that future risks, including melting ice sheets and permafrost, could be underestimated. Dr. Deepashree Dutta, who led the study, noticed the models’ limitations during her doctoral research. Her team hypothesized that polar stratospheric clouds—which are largely missing from most climate simulations—might be the key missing factor. To investigate, the researchers used models that included these high-altitude clouds and discovered that they had a significant warming effect, especially during the Eocene period when Earth was much warmer and the Arctic was ice-free. Published in Nature Geoscience on November 7, their study found that adding polar stratospheric clouds to climate models brought simulated temperatures closer to those recorded in ancient climate data. Climate models are advanced computer programs that attempt to represent the global climate system. Because not every atmospheric process can be included, these models often underestimate the warming at the poles seen in real-world measurements. Increasing the model's complexity for better detail also demands more computing resources, so certain trade-offs are made. The idea that polar stratospheric clouds could influence ancient polar warming dates back to a 1992 proposal by Dr. Lisa Sloan. These clouds, which appear at very cold temperatures between 15–25 km above the polar regions, can reflect vivid colors and, like greenhouse gases, trap heat and warm the Earth's surface. Dr. Dutta's team revisited this hypothesis with a new model, considering conditions from the early Eocene. They found high methane and continental arrangements at the time favored more stratospheric cloud formation, leading to as much as 7°C additional surface warming in the coldest months. Their research also highlights the importance of continental positions, alongside methane, for cloud formation. When comparing ancient periods to possible future scenarios, the researchers concluded that similar increases in stratospheric cloud formation are unlikely today, since Earth's continents have shifted from their Eocene positions. So although PSCs significantly affected ancient polar warmth, they probably won’t have as big of a role going forward. The study underlines the importance of making climate models as realistic as possible. Including atmospheric features like polar stratospheric clouds can help close the gap between predictions and actual data, deepening our understanding of both past and future climates.
translated_content: Onderzoekers van UNSW Sydney hebben ontdekt dat stratosferische wolken boven het noordpoolgebied mogelijk verklaren waarom klimaatmodellen vaak de opwarming aan de polen onderschatten. Sinds het begin van het industriële tijdperk zijn de wereldwijde temperaturen gestegen, maar de opwarming aan de polen is nog sterker. Hoewel huidige klimaatmodellen hier deels rekening mee houden, slagen ze er vaak niet in om de sterkere waargenomen opwarming, vooral in oude klimaattijdperken zoals het Eoceen (met hoge broeikasgasniveaus), goed te voorspellen. Dit verschil zorgt ervoor dat het risico op bijvoorbeeld smeltende ijskappen en permafrost mogelijk wordt onderschat. Dr. Deepashree Dutta, die het onderzoek leidde, merkte tijdens haar promotie al de beperkingen van de modellen op. Haar team vermoedde dat polaire stratosferische wolken — die grotendeels ontbreken in de meeste klimaatsimulaties — wel eens de ontbrekende factor konden zijn. Om dit te onderzoeken gebruikten de onderzoekers modellen mét deze hoge wolken. Ze ontdekten dat ze een aanzienlijk opwarmend effect hebben, vooral tijdens het Eoceen, toen de aarde veel warmer was en de Noordpool het hele jaar door ijsvrij was. De resultaten, gepubliceerd in Nature Geoscience op 7 november, laten zien dat het toevoegen van polaire stratosferische wolken aan klimaatmodellen leidt tot simulaties die beter overeenkomen met oude klimaatgegevens. Klimaatmodellen zijn complexe computerprogramma’s die het wereldwijde klimaatsysteem proberen weer te geven. Omdat niet elk atmosferisch proces meegenomen kan worden, onderschatten deze modellen vaak de feitelijk gemeten opwarming aan de polen. Het toevoegen van meer detail vraagt ook om meer rekenkracht, dus er moeten afwegingen worden gemaakt. Het idee dat polaire stratosferische wolken invloed hebben op oude poolopwarming stamt al uit 1992, toen Dr. Lisa Sloan dit voorstelde. Deze wolken, die ontstaan op zeer koude temperaturen tussen 15–25 km hoogte boven de polen, kunnen felle kleuren tonen en houden net als broeikasgassen warmte vast nabij het aardoppervlak. Het team van Dr. Dutta onderzocht deze hypothese met een geavanceerd model en omstandigheden uit het vroege Eoceen. Hoge methaanniveaus en de toenmalige ligging van continenten bevorderden de vorming van meer stratosferische wolken, wat tot wel 7°C extra opwarming gaf in de koudste maanden. Het onderzoek laat ook zien dat niet alleen methaan, maar ook de positie van continenten essentieel is voor de wolkvorming. Als men het oude Eoceen vergelijkt met mogelijke toekomstige scenario’s, concluderen de onderzoekers dat we nu waarschijnlijk geen vergelijkbare toename aan stratosferische wolken zullen zien, omdat de continenten anders liggen dan toen. PSC’s hadden dus een sterke impact op de poolwarmte in het verleden, maar zullen waarschijnlijk een kleinere rol spelen voor de toekomst. Het onderzoek benadrukt het belang van realistische klimaatmodellen. Door atmosferische factoren zoals polaire stratosferische wolken mee te nemen, kan het verschil tussen model en werkelijkheid verkleind worden en krijgen we beter begrip van zowel vroegere als toekomstige klimaten.

The baby of Prince William and Kate Middleton (the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge) has not yet been born, but already has a special musical dedication. Composer Paul Mealor, who previously created music for the couple's royal wedding, has written a lullaby titled 'Sleep On' for their expected child, due in July. The song will be performed by acclaimed classical singer Hayley Westenra, who included 'Sleep On' on her new album of lullabies, 'Hushabye', set to be released in June. Westenra has dedicated the album to the royal baby and plans to send a copy to the couple as they prepare for their new arrival.

Mealor, age 37, is known for composing 'Wherever You Are' for Gareth Malone's Military Wives choir. He was commissioned to write 'Ubi Caritas' for William and Kate's wedding two years ago, which was considered a highlight of the event. Mealor said, 'After writing music for the Royal Wedding, it seemed natural to provide musical accompaniment for the next stage of the royal couple’s journey together.'

Westenra, who has performed for the Prince of Wales, explained that she and Mealor collaborated on 'Sleep On' to honor the approaching birth, calling it a joyous occasion for everyone to celebrate. The 'Hushabye' album features other calming lullabies such as 'Hushabye Mountain' and 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star,' designed to soothe both parents and children.

Over the past year, more student-loan borrowers have taken advantage of a new process to seek relief from their debt in court. On Thursday, the Education and Justice Departments announced the "successful first year" of their updated guidance, which aims to help borrowers discharge student loans through bankruptcy. Introduced in November 2022, the revised approach allows eligible borrowers to submit self-attestation forms, enabling the Justice Department to recommend debt relief to judges without lengthy investigations. Previously, borrowers had to meet the strict "undue hardship" standard—demonstrating they couldn't maintain a minimal standard of living, that their situation wasn't likely to improve, and that they had made good-faith efforts to repay. While these requirements remain, the new guidance streamlines the process to ensure more consistent treatment.

According to the departments, 632 cases were filed in the first ten months after the new guidance, with 97% of borrowers voluntarily using the updated process. Courts agreed to grant a full or partial discharge in 99% of cases where judgments were issued. "One year ago, we set out to simplify and improve the process for student loan borrowers in bankruptcy," Associate Attorney General Vanita Gupta said. "Our one-year review indicates that our efforts have made a real difference by making student-loan discharges more accessible."

However, the announcement did not specify how many borrowers have actually received discharges under the new guidance, and the Justice Department said it could not share that data yet. While the agency has conducted training for bankruptcy attorneys, Aaron Ament, president of the borrower advocacy group Student Defense, said further improvements are needed. "The progress is life-changing for some, but the number of actual discharges so far appears low," Ament said, also noting long delays in reviewing attestation forms. "The government must keep improving the process to achieve meaningful systemic change."

In August, Student Defense obtained data via the Freedom of Information Act, finding that fewer than 45 borrowers had received full or partial discharges under the new guidance. The Education Department commented that the guidance was still new but represented an important step toward clearer and fairer standards for discharging student debt through bankruptcy. Both Democratic and Republican lawmakers have pushed for even greater accessibility. Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren requested updated data from Attorney General Merrick Garland, and Florida Governor Ron DeSantis expressed support for making student loan relief available through bankruptcy. DeSantis said, "We've had a generation of students go deep into debt, and some degrees are not making a difference. Student loans should be dischargeable in bankruptcy."

In het afgelopen jaar hebben steeds meer studenten met studieleningen gebruikgemaakt van een nieuw proces om via de rechtbank van hun schulden af te komen. Donderdag maakten de ministeries van Onderwijs en Justitie een "succesvol eerste jaar" bekend van hun aangepaste richtlijnen om studieleningen via faillissement te laten kwijtschelden. Deze aanpak, geïntroduceerd in november 2022, stelt in aanmerking komende leners in staat om zelfverklaringsformulieren in te dienen, waardoor het ministerie van Justitie de rechtbank kan adviseren over schuldverlichting zonder langdurige onderzoeken. Voorheen moesten leners voldoen aan de strikte norm van "onredelijke hardheid"—aantonen dat ze niet in staat zijn een minimaal bestaansniveau te behouden, dat hun situatie waarschijnlijk niet zal verbeteren en dat ze te goeder trouw hebben geprobeerd de lening af te lossen. Hoewel deze eisen blijven bestaan, stroomlijnen de nieuwe richtlijnen het proces voor een meer consistente behandeling.

Volgens de ministeries zijn er in de eerste tien maanden na de nieuwe richtlijnen 632 zaken ingediend, waarbij 97% van de leners vrijwillig het nieuwe proces heeft gevolgd. In 99% van de zaken waarin een vonnis is uitgesproken, stemden de rechtbanken in met volledige of gedeeltelijke kwijtschelding. "Een jaar geleden stelden we ons ten doel het proces voor studieleners bij faillissement eenvoudiger en beter te maken," zei plaatsvervangend procureur-generaal Vanita Gupta. "Onze evaluatie laat zien dat onze inspanningen daadwerkelijk verschil maken doordat studielening-kwijtschelding toegankelijker is geworden."

Toch werd er in de aankondiging niet gemeld hoeveel leners daadwerkelijk hun leningen kwijtgescholden zagen onder deze richtlijnen, en het ministerie van Justitie gaf aan deze gegevens nog niet te kunnen delen. Ondanks dat het ministerie trainingen verzorgde voor faillissementsadvocaten, vond Aaron Ament, voorzitter van belangenorganisatie Student Defense, dat verdere verbeteringen noodzakelijk zijn. "De vooruitgang is levensveranderend voor sommigen, maar het aantal daadwerkelijke kwijtscheldingen lijkt tot nu toe laag," aldus Ament, die ook opmerkt dat er flinke vertragingen zijn bij het beoordelen van de formulieren. "De overheid moet het proces blijven verbeteren om echte structurele verandering te bereiken."

In augustus kreeg Student Defense via de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur gegevens waaruit bleek dat minder dan 45 leners volledige of gedeeltelijke kwijtschelding hebben gekregen onder het nieuwe beleid. Het ministerie van Onderwijs gaf aan dat de richtlijnen nog nieuw zijn, maar dat dit een belangrijke stap is richting eerlijkere standaarden voor het kwijtschelden van studieleningen via faillissement. Zowel Democratische als Republikeinse politici pleiten voor nog meer toegankelijkheid. Senator Elizabeth Warren uit Massachusetts vroeg minister van Justitie Merrick Garland om aanvullende cijfers, en de gouverneur van Florida, Ron DeSantis, sprak steun uit voor het mogelijk maken van schuldverlichting voor studieleningen via faillissement. DeSantis zei: "We hebben een generatie studenten met enorme schulden en sommige diploma’s leveren weinig op. Studieleningen moeten via faillissement aflosbaar zijn."

Oscar Pistorius, once celebrated as a Paralympic champion, is again pursuing early parole from the South African prison where he is serving over 13 years for the 2013 murder of his girlfriend, Reeva Steenkamp. The incident, which occurred at his Pretoria home, shocked the world.

Reeva’s mother, June Steenkamp, is not opposing Pistorius’s bid for parole, but she remains doubtful that he has truly reformed. In her statement, read to the parole board at Atteridgeville prison, June explained that she could not attend in person, especially after the recent passing of her husband, Barry, which resurfaced the pain of losing Reeva.

June’s victim impact statement raised concerns about Pistorius’s willingness to accept full responsibility for his actions. She questioned his account that he mistook Reeva for an intruder, noting her daughter screamed so loudly that neighbors could hear.

Reeva Steenkamp, who was 29, worked as a model and held a law degree. She was killed when Pistorius fired four shots into a bathroom door, reportedly believing there was an intruder. Pistorius was initially convicted of culpable homicide but later found guilty of murder by the Supreme Court of Appeal, which found discrepancies in his recollection and ruled that he fired without genuine fear for his safety.

The parole board is evaluating Pistorius’s record, rehabilitation, and risk to the public. An earlier parole hearing was canceled due to a technical error, but the Constitutional Court has since resolved the issue, and a new hearing is underway.

Pistorius, whose legs were amputated as a child, became renowned as the “blade runner,” winning multiple Paralympic titles and competing in the 2012 Olympics with able-bodied athletes. The shooting and subsequent trial brought widespread international media coverage.

Oscar Pistorius, ooit beroemd als Paralympisch kampioen, probeert opnieuw vervroegd vrij te komen uit de Zuid-Afrikaanse gevangenis waar hij meer dan 13 jaar vastzit voor de moord op zijn vriendin Reeva Steenkamp in 2013. Het incident in zijn huis in Pretoria schokte de wereld.

Reeva’s moeder, June Steenkamp, verzet zich niet tegen het verzoek om vervroegde vrijlating van Pistorius, maar twijfelt of hij daadwerkelijk is veranderd. In haar verklaring, die werd voorgelezen tijdens de hoorzitting in de Atteridgeville-gevangenis, gaf June aan dat ze niet persoonlijk kon komen, zeker niet na het recente overlijden van haar man Barry. Dat verlies bracht het verdriet om Reeva’s dood weer helemaal terug.

In haar slachtofferverklaring uitte June haar zorgen over Pistorius' bereidheid om volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor zijn daden. Ze gelooft niet dat zijn verhaal klopt dat hij Reeva voor een indringer aanzag; ze wijst erop dat haar dochter zo hard schreeuwde dat de buren het konden horen.

Reeva Steenkamp was 29, werkte als model en was afgestudeerd in de rechten. Ze werd gedood doordat Pistorius vier keer door een badkamerdeur schoot, naar eigen zeggen denkend dat er een indringer was. Pistorius werd eerst veroordeeld voor doodslag, maar later door het Hooggerechtshof schuldig bevonden aan moord omdat zijn verhaal inconsistent bleek en men vond dat hij zonder daadwerkelijke angst handelde.

De commissie voor voorwaardelijke vrijlating beoordeelt Pistorius’ achtergrond, gedrag in de gevangenis en het risico voor de samenleving. Een eerdere hoorzitting mislukte door een procedurefout, maar het Constitutioneel Hof heeft die opgelost. Nu loopt de nieuwe hoorzitting verder.

article_content: Production is underway in Atlanta for 'Open Wounds', an independent horror thriller directed by Ronald Krauss. The film stars Jack Kilmer, Paris Jackson, and Eric Roberts. The narrative follows Caleb, a young enthusiast aiming to become a special effects artist in the horror film industry. Caleb gets his break when his uncle Jefferson, owner of a declining indie horror studio, assigns him to work on a B-list vampire film. On this project, Caleb crosses paths with another makeup artist named Ginni and faces rivalry from Todd. Eager to gain Jefferson's approval, Caleb's ambition leads him down a dark path after he accidentally witnesses a murder. He incorporates the grim realism of the event into his special effects work, earning praise from Jefferson and the movie crew. This success soon turns sinister, as Caleb resorts to violence for inspiration, losing his moral direction. Amidst these events, his relationship with Ginni deepens in unconventional ways. 'Open Wounds' is produced by Day 28 Films and Bald Eagle Entertainment, with Ronald Krauss and Ira Houston as producers. Executive production is handled by Chung Dick and Thomas Carroll, while Haweni Keskessa and Marvin Cheng are co-producers. The screenplay is authored by Krauss, Ryan Leeder, and Joshua Courtade. Jack Kilmer brings experience from roles in 'Palo Alto' and as narrator of the documentary 'Val', which chronicles the life of his father Val Kilmer. He recently starred in 'The Tower.' Paris Jackson, who has acted in series like 'Swarm' and the film 'Gringo', is active as both an actor and musician. Eric Roberts, known for roles in 'The Dark Knight' and several Oscar-nominated films, continues a prolific career with projects like 'Down Below.' Ronald Krauss is known for directing 'Gimme Shelter.'

article_content: LONDON — Climate activist Greta Thunberg has been charged with a public order offense after being arrested during a protest against an oil and gas industry conference in London. According to the Metropolitan Police, the 20-year-old Swedish campaigner was among 26 people charged after protesters gathered outside the luxury InterContinental Hotel during the Energy Intelligence Forum. Thunberg was part of a group of demonstrators who chanted “oily money out” and attempted to block access to the hotel on Tuesday. She was detained, taken to a police station, and later released overnight. Authorities charged her with breaching a section of the Public Order Act that permits police to set restrictions on public gatherings. Thunberg was released on bail and is due to appear in London’s Westminster Magistrates’ Court on November 15. The other protesters charged were also released on bail. The three-day conference—which runs until Thursday—features speakers such as the chief executives of Shell, Saudi Arabia’s Aramco, and Norway’s Equinor, as well as the UK’s energy security minister. Protesters have accused fossil fuel companies of intentionally slowing the global move to renewable energy to maintain profits. They also object to the British government’s recent approval for oil drilling in the North Sea, off Scotland’s coast. Thunberg is known for inspiring a global youth movement calling for stronger action on climate change after launching weekly protests outside Sweden’s parliament in 2018. She was recently fined by a Swedish court for disobeying police during a climate demonstration.

Volgens de Metropolitan Police was de 20-jarige Zweedse activiste een van de 26 personen die werden aangeklaagd nadat demonstranten zich verzamelden buiten het luxe InterContinental Hotel tijdens het Energy Intelligence Forum. Thunberg maakte deel uit van een groep demonstranten die 'oily money out' scandeerden en probeerden dinsdag de toegang tot het hotel te blokkeren. Thunberg staat bekend om het inspireren van een wereldwijde jongerenbeweging die oproept tot krachtigere actie tegen klimaatverandering, nadat zij in 2018 begon met wekelijkse protesten bij het Zweedse parlement. Ze kreeg recentelijk in Zweden een boete omdat ze tijdens een klimaatdemonstratie de aanwijzingen van de politie niet opvolgde.

article_content: Apple has announced a one-year extension for the free Emergency SOS via satellite feature for iPhone 14 users. This service, introduced with the iPhone 14 series, enables users to contact emergency services by satellite when they are outside of cellular coverage. Initially bundled with two years of complimentary access, the offer now covers three years for early adopters who activated their devices before the announcement date. The Emergency SOS via satellite service is also included for all iPhone 15 models, which start their own two-year free period upon activation. The feature is currently available in 16 countries and regions, including the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Portugal, Spain, and Switzerland. Users activate the feature by going outdoors with a clear view of the sky. The iPhone provides guidance using software and GPS to help locate a satellite connection. Communications with emergency services are conducted via text, and the user's location is shared with both responders and emergency contacts. In the U.S., Apple has also launched Roadside Assistance via satellite, allowing users to connect with AAA if their vehicle breaks down outside network coverage. For general safety, the Find My app lets users share their location with friends and family when off the grid. Apple reports that the service has already assisted in saving lives during its first year of operation, citing incidents such as the rescue of a man after his car fell 400 feet in Los Angeles. Reactions to Apple’s extension have been largely positive. Analyst Ian Fogg remarked that extending the free period makes sense, as it is difficult to justify charging for emergency aid. Other commentators, like Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, speculate that the move may be due to delays in Apple finalizing its payment structure for the service, though others are skeptical and suggest broader strategic motives. The competitive landscape is also changing, with Samsung announcing satellite connectivity in its upcoming Galaxy S24 devices and Huawei already offering similar features on the P60 series. Qualcomm and Iridium have ended their partnership on proprietary satellite-to-phone services, indicating that manufacturers prefer Apple’s approach. Some voices, such as software developer Richard Hyland, argue that emergency features like this should remain free or be bundled with services like Apple One, as users only need them in rare, urgent situations. With rivals entering the market and satellite SOS features likely to become standard, Apple’s move positions it favorably, both for public relations and in offering value to consumers. The free extension currently lasts until at least November 2025, and further developments may follow as Apple continues to expand its satellite capabilities.

De gratis verlenging duurt zeker tot november 2025 en verdere ontwikkelingen kunnen volgen terwijl Apple zijn satellietmogelijkheden blijft uitbreiden.

article_content: Kapil Sharma took to social media on Saturday to wish his wife, Ginni Chatrath, a happy birthday. He chose two memorable photographs from their vacation abroad for the occasion. In his caption, Kapil expressed his gratitude, writing, 'Happy birthday @ginnichatrath, thank you for everything #love #happiness #blessings.' Kapil’s post received numerous messages and blessings from fans and friends. The most notable comment came from his The Kapil Sharma Show co-star, Archana Puran Singh, who wrote, 'Wish you the happiest Birthday Ginni. Such lovely photographs… so finally Kapil took you ‘bahar’… itna bahar ki desh se hi bahar nikal pade tum dono!! (Finally Kapil took you outside, so much so that both of you went abroad!) Have fun celebrating. Love you both so much!' Kapil responded to Archana’s comment with, '@archanapuransingh hahahaha, thank you ma'am.' Other friends from the entertainment industry, such as Sayani Gupta, Paritosh R Tripathi, Parmeet Sethi, and Guneet Monga, also sent their wishes. Kapil and Ginni’s relationship began when she was in college, and he had started teaching theatre. In a recent podcast called Feel It In Your Soul, Kapil shared that Ginni’s father interviewed him when they started dating. 'When I was in college, artistes weren’t valued. Even when I met Ginni’s father, it was only his immense love for Ginni that he agreed to meet and interview me. Normally, a typical father wouldn’t have done so,' Kapil said. 'At that time, I was earning good money from TV, but he didn’t believe it. He asked if I could earn Rs 5-10k in a day. I told him I made more than that. He was surprised and asked, Is it possible to earn that much?' Kapil and Ginni eventually married in 2018 in Jalandhar. They are parents to a daughter, Anayra, who is 4, and a son, Trishaan, who is two.

A leaked internal memo has revealed that Hacked Off—a group advocating for stronger press regulation following the phone hacking scandals—devised a deliberate strategy to win over Conservative MPs opposed to then-Prime Minister David Cameron. The confidential document explains Hacked Off’s plan to set aside disagreements with certain right-wing MPs and exploit divisions within the Conservative party to advance their push for tougher oversight of the press.

The strategy centered around the ‘Dowler test’, invoking the public uproar over the hacking of murdered schoolgirl Millie Dowler’s phone. According to the memo, while the phrase had entered public conversations, Hacked Off intended to better define and leverage it to strengthen their reform arguments. Public outrage over claims—later discredited—that News of the World journalists deleted phone messages in Dowler’s case led to the paper’s shutdown.

This leak is the most comprehensive glimpse into Hacked Off’s campaign tactics since its founding after the Dowler scandal. Fronted by actor Hugh Grant and formed under the Media Standards Trust, Hacked Off has called for more openness in the relationship between politicians and the press, though critics argue it has not been sufficiently transparent about its own operations or finances.

Sources indicate Hacked Off received discreet assistance from BBM, a lobbying agency with ties to former Labour advisers. The plan, drafted by campaign chief Ella Mason and signed off by leadership—Hugh Grant, Brian Cathcart, and Charlotte Harris—sought to recruit 30–40 Conservative MPs, specifically those with personal or political grievances against Mr. Cameron, hoping to gain their support in a crucial House of Commons vote on media reform.

Senior Conservative MP David Davis criticized Hacked Off’s approach as hypocritical, pointing to discrepancies between their stated values and internal methods. The whistleblower who leaked the document voiced discomfort with the group’s tactics. The memo was reportedly discussed in a meeting at law firm Mishcon de Reya, attended by Hacked Off’s leadership.

With an important Parliamentary vote on press regulation approaching—with Labour’s Ed Miliband and Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg backing state regulation—the outcome was believed to depend on whether enough Conservatives would vote against party lines. The memo’s primary goal was the establishment of an independent press regulator with real enforcement power.

Hacked Off responded by saying that their efforts included MPs from all parties, and denied intentionally targeting specific groups. The group acknowledged that BBM had provided some guidance but were not formally employed; Gez Sagar, a BBM director, gave advice pro bono. Hacked Off reaffirmed their commitment to defending the rights of press abuse victims.

In het vertrouwelijke document staat beschreven hoe Hacked Off besloten had verschillen met rechtse parlementsleden opzij te zetten en verdeeldheid binnen de Conservatieve Partij te benutten om strengere mediatoezicht af te dwingen.

Centraal daarin stond de zogenaamde 'Dowler-test', waarmee werd ingehaakt op de publieke verontwaardiging over het hacken van de telefoon van de vermoorde scholiere Millie Dowler. Het memo meldt dat het begrip al opdook in discussies, maar dat Hacked Off het duidelijker wilde definiëren om het als argument voor pershervormingen te kunnen gebruiken. Publieke woede over inmiddels weerlegde beschuldigingen—dat journalisten van de News of the World berichten van Dowlers telefoon zouden hebben verwijderd, waardoor haar familie valselijk hoop kreeg—leidde tot de sluiting van de krant.

Dit lek biedt het meest volledig beeld tot nu toe van Hacked Off's interne tactieken sinds haar oprichting na het Dowler-incident. Geleid door acteur Hugh Grant en opgericht onder de vlag van de Media Standards Trust, dringt Hacked Off aan op meer openheid tussen de pers en politici. Tegelijk vinden critici dat Hacked Off zelf niet genoeg transparant is over haar eigen financiering en contacten.

Volgens bronnen kreeg Hacked Off op de achtergrond hulp van BBM, een lobbykantoor gelinkt aan voormalige Labour-adviseurs. Het plan, opgesteld door campagnedirecteur Ella Mason en goedgekeurd door onder meer Hugh Grant, Brian Cathcart en Charlotte Harris, was om 30 à 40 Conservatieve Lagerhuisleden te benaderen—met name die met persoonlijke of politieke bezwaren tegen Cameron—in de hoop hun steun binnen te halen bij een naderende stemming in het Lagerhuis over mediakwesties.

Vooraanstaand Conservatief parlementslid David Davis noemde de handelswijze van Hacked Off hypocriet en wees op het verschil tussen hun normen en hun interne aanpak. De klokkenluider die het document lekte gaf aan zich ongemakkelijk te voelen bij de tactieken van de organisatie. Het memo werd besproken op een bijeenkomst bij het advocatenkantoor Mishcon de Reya, waar het Hacked Off-leiderschap bij aanwezig was.

Voor een beslissende stemming in het Parlement over persregulering—gesteund door Labour-leider Ed Miliband en vicepremier Nick Clegg—zou het afwijken van de partijlijn door genoeg Conservatieven doorslaggevend kunnen zijn. Het doel van het memo was de invoering van een onafhankelijke perswaakhond met daadwerkelijke handhavingsbevoegdheden.

Hacked Off liet weten zich te richten op Kamerleden uit alle partijen en niet bewust groepen tegenover elkaar wilde uitspelen. Men gaf toe dat BBM in sommige gevallen had geadviseerd, maar benadrukte dat er geen formele samenwerking was; BBM’s Gez Sagar gaf onbezoldigd advies. Hacked Off herhaalde haar inzet voor de rechten van slachtoffers van persmisbruik.

Less than a week after winning a $96.5 million Powerball prize, John and Susan Brands of St. Charles, Missouri, have already started transforming their lives and planning for the future. The Missouri Lottery identified the 49-year-old couple as the winners of the March 22 drawing. According to a news release, Susan, who is currently studying web design, intends to finish out her semester. The couple also plan to replace their older-model vehicles.

After discovering that his ticket matched all five numbers plus the Powerball, John, originally from Portageville, Missouri, decided to quit his job as a civil engineer. He is now considering buying farmland, echoing a famous line from the movie 'O Brother, Where Art Thou': 'You ain't no kind of man, if you ain't got land.'

Susan, a Wichita, Kansas native, is eager to travel, particularly to New Zealand. 'We're nerds,' she explained, noting their fascination with New Zealand as the filming location for 'The Lord of the Rings' and 'The Hobbit.'

With their newfound financial freedom, John and Susan are looking forward to pursuing other interests they previously lacked time for, including learning new languages, attending culinary school, and John taking guitar lessons. The winning ticket, selected by computer, was purchased at Bridgeton Mobil in suburban St. Louis. The winning numbers were 13, 28, 31, 55, 58, and Powerball 15.

article_content: Mozilla, recognized for its Firefox browser and Pocket app, is shifting its focus to the 'fediverse'—a system of decentralized social platforms that operate via the ActivityPub protocol. Moving away from mainstream corporate-run social networks, Mozilla aspires to redesign the social media landscape by placing user interests at the forefront. Through participation in the fediverse, Mozilla encourages environments where people have greater say over their online experiences and data privacy. As a project of a nonprofit, Mozilla can prioritize user needs without pressure from investors or shareholders. In 2022, Mozilla joined decentralized alternatives like Mastodon, launching its own Mastodon server in private beta. This effort emphasizes Mozilla’s dedication to creating a secure, inclusive, and privacy-oriented web—free from profit-driven interests. The new Mastodon instance enhances the fediverse, supporting those who value digital freedom and open communication. Carolyn O’Hara, Mozilla’s Senior Director of Content, explained that Mozilla’s approach isn’t about attracting vast numbers but about offering users meaningful options and control in line with its core values. O’Hara highlighted that the main goal is a transparent, secure, and privacy-first platform true to Mozilla’s commitment to an open web. By doing so, Mozilla aims to empower users to better control their digital lives.

Door actief te worden in de fediverse, stimuleert Mozilla platforms waar mensen meer regie hebben over hun online identiteit en privacy. Als onderdeel van een non-profitorganisatie, kan Mozilla keuzes maken die het beste zijn voor gebruikers, in plaats van investeerders of aandeelhouders tevreden te moeten stellen. In 2022 trad Mozilla toe tot andere gedecentraliseerde platforms zoals Mastodon door hun eigen Mastodon-server in private bèta te lanceren. Dit initiatief benadrukt Mozilla’s inzet voor een veilige, inclusieve en privacygerichte digitale ruimte—zonder commerciële doeleinden. De nieuwe Mastodon-instantie verrijkt de fediverse en ondersteunt mensen die digitale vrijheid en open communicatie belangrijk vinden. Carolyn O’Hara, Senior Director of Content bij Mozilla, onderstreepte dat Mozilla niet mikt op een grote gebruikersgroei, maar juist alternatieven en autonomie wil bieden in lijn met hun kernwaarden. Volgens O’Hara is het belangrijkste doel een transparant, veilig en privacyvriendelijk platform dat trouw blijft aan Mozilla’s visie van een open internet. Hiermee wil Mozilla gebruikers meer controle geven over hun online leven.

article_content: Brothers Kim and Lee Hughes work together in Afghanistan, specializing in the hazardous job of clearing improvised explosive devices (IEDs). Kim, 34, is acclaimed as one of Britain’s most brave bomb disposal agents, having earned the George Cross in 2009 for his outstanding courage. He currently oversees military bomb disposal teams operating in Helmand province. Their teamwork extends beyond their unit: Lee, 35, is a staff sergeant in the same 11 Explosive Ordnance Disposal Regiment, and both take pride in collaborating without sibling rivalry—just professional respect. Their step-brother, Matthew Heppenstall, 27, plans to join their regiment soon. Kim’s George Cross was earned after an intense mission in Sangin, Helmand, in August 2009, where a series of IED explosions struck British troops. Risking his own safety and foregoing protective equipment to save time, Kim successfully disarmed seven bombs to rescue wounded soldiers, although some had already lost their lives. Over his deployment, he removed more than 80 improvised explosives. Currently, Kim manages operations while Lee continues dangerous field assignments. Together, they have helped train Afghan National Security Forces, empowering them to lead EOD activities. Kim recognizes the progress: Afghan teams now handle most bomb disposal operations, with British support provided as needed. Lee, now on his third deployment, has also faced life-threatening situations—once finding himself only a foot from a hidden device. He credits his inspiration to pursue bomb disposal work to Kim. Their mother, Francis, 54, has long endured anxiety as she follows her sons' military careers in conflict zones. The Hughes family's story highlights dedication, expertise, and a shared resolve to improve Afghanistan’s capacity to confront explosive threats.

Op dit moment leidt hij militaire teams die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het opsporen en ruimen van IED's in de provincie Helmand. De familieband werkt door in hun beroep: Lee, 35, is stafsergeant in hetzelfde 11 Explosive Ordnance Disposal Regiment. Beide broers benadrukken hun professionele respect zonder rivaliteit. Hun stiefbroer, Matthew Heppenstall, 27, voegt zich binnenkort bij hun regiment. Kim kreeg het George Cross na een intensieve missie in Sangin, Helmand, in augustus 2009, waarbij een reeks IED-explosies Britse soldaten trof. Door zonder beschermende kleding te werken wist Kim zeven bommen onschadelijk te maken en gewonde soldaten te redden, hoewel sommigen het niet overleefden. Tijdens deze missie heeft hij in totaal meer dan 80 explosieven opgeruimd. Tegenwoordig stuurt Kim de operaties aan terwijl Lee nog steeds in het veld werkt. Het verhaal van de familie Hughes staat symbool voor toewijding, vakmanschap en gezamenlijke inzet om Afghanistan beter te beschermen tegen explosieve dreiging.

article_content: Team 17 has long subscribed to the philosophy: 'If it isn’t broken, don’t fix it.' This is especially true for their beloved Worms series. While the core gameplay has seen only minor adjustments over the last decade, these tweaks have prevented the games from feeling outdated. Worms 3 marks a slight departure from tradition as it is designed exclusively for mobile devices. Players shouldn’t expect drastic changes, but new weapons have been added to refresh the familiar formula. Alongside the classic pass-and-play multiplayer mode, players can now compete online in both ranked and friendly matches, and challenge themselves in the single-player Bodycount mode to beat their friends’ scores. The game features 27 single-player missions spread across four themes: Beach, Spooky, Farmyard, and Sewer. An improved in-game menu system keeps players updated on Worms news worldwide. Battle mechanics have also improved. A new in-game class system lets players choose between Heavy, Scientist, Scout, and the classic Soldier. Fresh weapons like Nora's Virus, the Blackhole Grenade, and Canned Heat join the arsenal. For those who prefer playing on a larger screen, the AirPlay feature allows the game to be displayed on Apple TV. Up to four players can enjoy the action together, with the active player plotting their moves discreetly on an iOS device while others watch on the TV. Worms 3 is set to launch for iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch via the App Store on August 8. Worms demonstrates that simple, accessible games still have a strong following. Worms 3 wijkt een beetje af van de traditie, want deze versie is exclusief ontworpen voor mobiele apparaten. Verwacht geen drastische veranderingen, maar er zijn nieuwe wapens toegevoegd om het bekende concept op te frissen. Naast de klassieke 'pass and play'-multiplayer kun je nu ook online spelen in zowel gerangschikte als vriendschappelijke wedstrijden, of jezelf uitdagen in de singleplayer Bodycount-modus om betere scores dan je vrienden te halen. Het spel bevat 27 singleplayer-missies verspreid over vier thema’s: Strand, Spooky, Boerderij en Riool. Een vernieuwd in-game menusysteem houdt spelers wereldwijd op de hoogte van het laatste Worms-nieuws. Ook de gevechtsmechanieken zijn verbeterd. Met een nieuw klassensysteem kies je tussen Heavy, Scientist, Scout en de klassieke Soldier. Nieuwe wapens zoals Nora’s Virus, de Blackhole Grenade en Canned Heat breiden het arsenaal uit. Worms 3 verschijnt op 8 augustus voor iPhone, iPad en iPod touch in de App Store. Worms bewijst dat eenvoudige, toegankelijke games nog steeds ontzettend in trek zijn.
